title: Labor Market Dynamics, Monetary Policy Tradeoffs, and a Shortfalls Approach to Pursuing Maximum Employment
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

detail.title: Labor Market Dynamics, Monetary Policy Tradeoffs, and a Shortfalls Approach to Pursuing Maximum Employment

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-068, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.068]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper reviews recent academic studies to assess the implications of adopting a shortfalls, rather than a deviations, approach to pursuing maximum employment.  Model-based simulations from these studies suggest three main findings.  First, shortfalls rules generate inflationary pressure relative to deviations rules, which offsets downward pressure on inflation stemming from the presence of the effective lower bound.  Second, since monetary policy leans against these inflationary pressures, a shortfalls rule implies a limited effect on average outcomes in the labor market.  Finally, studies suggest that monetary policy can offset higher-than-desired average inflation under a shortfalls rule by leaning more strongly against deviations of inflation from the 2 percent objective, thereby keeping longer-term inflation expectations well anchored.

title: Pandemic and War Inflation: Lessons from the International Experience
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond

detail.title: Pandemic and War Inflation: Lessons from the International Experience

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the drivers of the 2020-23 inflation surge, with an emphasis on the similarities and differences across countries, as well as the role that monetary policy frameworks might have played in shaping central banks' responses.  The inflation surge in the U.S. and abroad was set in motion by two global events: the COVID-19 pandemic and Russia's invasion of Ukraine.  Pandemic-related supply disruptions, a rotation of consumer spending toward goods, and commodity price increases exacerbated by Russia's invasion of Ukraine resulted in unusually large relative price increases, which required time to be absorbed.  A simple Phillips curve framework suggests that the inflation surge was mainly driven by "cost push" factors, such as supply shortages and relative price shifts.  Tight labor markets contributed to the persistence of above-target inflation.  Despite differences in mandates of the monetary policy frameworks, central banks around the world responded similarly to recent global events.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2020-2023年全球通胀激增的驱动因素，重点关注各国间的异同以及货币政策框架在央行应对措施中的作用。通胀主要由COVID-19疫情和俄乌战争引发的供应链中断、消费转向商品以及大宗商品价格上涨等"成本推动"因素驱动，而紧张的劳动力市场加剧了通胀持续性。
AI.research_question: 2020-23年全球通胀激增的驱动因素是什么？各国间有何异同？货币政策框架如何影响央行的应对措施？
AI.motivation: 理解近期全球通胀激增的根本原因，分析不同国家通胀表现的异同，探讨货币政策框架在应对通胀中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 菲利普斯曲线框架，强调"成本推动"因素（供给短缺和相对价格变动）对通胀的影响。
AI.method: 基于菲利普斯曲线的理论分析框架，结合对全球事件的实证观察。
AI.findings: 通胀激增主要由COVID-19疫情和俄乌战争引发的供应链中断、消费转向商品以及大宗商品价格上涨等成本推动因素驱动；紧张的劳动力市场加剧了通胀持续性；尽管各国货币政策框架不同，但央行应对措施相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对成本推动型通胀机制的理解，强调了相对价格变动在通胀动态中的重要性，为理解全球冲击下的通胀传导机制提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对类似全球冲击的参考，强调了在成本推动型通胀环境下货币政策面临的挑战，有助于改进通胀预测和政策反应机制。

title: Inflation since the Pandemic: Lessons and Challenges
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, , Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Inflation since the Pandemic: Lessons and Challenges

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-070, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.070]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper reviews the drivers of the post-pandemic U.S. inflation surge and subsequent decline, including the behavior and role of inflation expectations.  The sharp rise in inflation reflected severe imbalances between supply and demand stemming from the shocks of the pandemic and the policy response.  Measures of short-term inflation expectations increased alongside realized inflation, especially those of households and firms, which may have contributed to inflation's persistence through price- and wage-setting behavior.  However, measures of longer-term inflation expectations remained generally well anchored, which likely prevented a larger or more lasting increase in inflation.  The stability of longer-term inflation expectations, together with easing supply and demand imbalances, allowed inflation to fall from its peak in mid-2022 without a large increase in unemployment.  We conclude by reviewing some lessons learned from this episode as well as potential risks to inflation going forward.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了疫情后美国通胀飙升和随后下降的驱动因素，包括通胀预期的行为和角色。通胀急剧上升反映了疫情和政策应对导致的供需严重失衡。短期通胀预期指标随实际通胀上升，可能通过价格和工资设定行为加剧了通胀持续性。但长期通胀预期保持稳定，这阻止了通胀更大幅度和更持久的上升。长期通胀预期的稳定性加上供需失衡缓解，使通胀从2022年中峰值回落而失业率未大幅上升。

AI.motivation: 理解疫情后美国通胀动态的成因，特别是通胀预期在通胀持续性和回落过程中的作用，为未来政策制定提供经验教训。

AI.method: 文献综述和实证分析，考察通胀预期指标与实际通胀的关系
AI.findings: 1) 通胀飙升源于疫情和政策应对导致的供需失衡；2) 短期通胀预期随实际通胀上升，可能加剧通胀持续性；3) 长期通胀预期保持稳定，阻止了通胀更大幅上升；4) 长期预期稳定和供需缓解使通胀回落而失业率未大幅上升

title: Monetary Policy, Uncertainty, and Communications
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Monetary Policy, Uncertainty, and Communications

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-074, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.074]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We review the design and communication of monetary policy strategies that take into account risks and uncertainty.  A key element in a robust monetary strategy is the concept of risk management, which is the weighing of key risks when setting policy.  When risks to the outlook are balanced, the baseline outlook may be sufficient to guide policy decisions.  However, risk-management considerations become important when risks are asymmetric.  We discuss how robust simple interest rate rules and optimal control policy can incorporate risk-management considerations into the design of a monetary policy strategy.  Alternative scenarios can illustrate salient risks and how monetary policy might respond if those risks were to materialize.  However, using alternative scenarios in policy deliberations and communications requires important implementation choices.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了考虑风险和不确定性的货币政策策略的设计与沟通，强调风险管理在稳健货币政策中的核心作用，特别是在风险不对称时的重要性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和沟通考虑风险与不确定性的货币政策策略？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策主要基于基线预测，但在风险不对称的情况下，需要更系统的风险管理方法来增强政策稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险管理理论、稳健货币政策设计、不对称风险分析
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析，探讨稳健简单利率规则和最优控制政策如何整合风险管理考量
AI.findings: 风险管理在风险不对称时尤为重要；替代情景分析可以展示关键风险及其政策应对；政策沟通需要审慎的实施选择
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了将风险管理纳入货币政策设计的理论框架，提出了风险不对称情况下的政策应对策略
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行提供了实用的风险管理工具和沟通策略，帮助政策制定者在不确定性环境下做出更稳健的决策

title: Accounting for Uncertainty and Risks in Monetary Policy
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Accounting for Uncertainty and Risks in Monetary Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-073, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.073]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper discusses the measurement, assessment, and communication of risks and uncertainty that are relevant for monetary policy.  It provides a taxonomy of policy-relevant uncertainty related to the state and the structure of the economy, and the formation of expectations.  A wide range of tools is available to assess and quantify uncertainty and the balance of risks.  Qualitative assessments of uncertainty—in policy statements, minutes, and speeches—are the main tools to communicate uncertainty and the balance of risks across major central banks.  However, the use of quantitative tools for such communications—including scenario analysis—is evolving, and so far no clear consensus has emerged for best practices.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了与货币政策相关的风险和不确定性的测量、评估及沟通方法，提出了政策相关不确定性的分类体系，并分析了中央银行在沟通不确定性时使用的定性和定量工具。
AI.research_question: 如何有效测量、评估和沟通货币政策相关的风险和不确定性？
AI.motivation: 货币政策制定过程中面临各种不确定性，需要系统化的方法来识别、评估和沟通这些不确定性，以支持更有效的政策决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性分类框架，包括经济状态不确定性、经济结构不确定性和预期形成不确定性。
AI.method: 文献综述和中央银行实践分析，考察了定性和定量评估工具的应用。
AI.findings: 中央银行主要使用定性工具（政策声明、会议纪要、演讲）来沟通不确定性，而定量工具（包括情景分析）的使用仍在发展中，尚未形成最佳实践共识。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了货币政策相关不确定性的系统分类框架，为不确定性研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行提供了不确定性沟通的实践指导，有助于提高货币政策透明度和有效性。

title: Retrospective on the Federal Reserve Board Staff's Inflation Forecast Errors since 2019
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Retrospective on the Federal Reserve Board Staff's Inflation Forecast Errors since 2019

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-069, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.069]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper examines the Board staff's inflation forecast misses over the years following the COVID-19 outbreak, focusing on a timeline of what staff members knew when and lessons learned along the way. The staff significantly underestimated both the size and persistence of the inflationary surge that followed the reopening of the U.S. economy. As a result, staff members made various changes to their forecasting procedures, including using new types of data to inform their assessment of supply-demand imbalances in product and labor markets and to guide their judgmental forecast. Throughout, an important difficulty was the lack of similar historical episodes upon which to base a quantitative analysis. Over time, the innovations helped improve the staff's ability to understand and forecast inflation during this period.  However, considerable uncertainty remains about the quantitative contributions of the various drivers of the pandemic-period inflation as well as the applicability of the lessons from this episode for forecasting.

title: Monotone Ecological Inference
affiliations: Stanford University, Stanford Law School, Columbia University, Stanford Law School and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: Monotone Ecological Inference

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study monotone ecological inference, a partial identification approach to ecological inference. The approach exploits information about one or both of the following conditional associations: (1) outcome differences between groups within the same neighborhood, and (2) outcomes differences within the same group across neighborhoods with different group compositions. We show how assumptions about the sign of these conditional associations, whether individually or in relation to one another, can yield informative sharp bounds in ecological inference settings. We illustrate our proposed approach using county-level data to study differences in Covid-19 vaccination rates among Republicans and Democrats in the United States.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: Nature and Biodiversity Loss: A Research Agenda for Financial Economics
affiliations: Yale School of Management, New York University (NYU), New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Nature and Biodiversity Loss: A Research Agenda for Financial Economics

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We outline a research agenda to better understand the economic and financial consequences of nature and biodiversity loss. Our starting point is a simple model in which ecosystem services—such as pollination, water filtration, and carbon sequestration—enter economic production, and where nature degradation and climate change reinforce one another through a “Twin-Crises Multiplier.” We then extend this framework to allow for heterogeneity across firms, industries, and geographies in how they depend on, and in turn affect, nature. This broader perspective provides a foundation for empirical analyses of how biodiversity loss influences aggregate output, firm productivity, and financial risk. We conclude by identifying opportunities for asset pricing and corporate finance research to systematically incorporate nature and biodiversity into financial economics.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个研究议程，旨在理解自然和生物多样性丧失的经济和金融后果。通过构建生态系统服务进入经济生产的模型，探讨自然退化与气候变化通过"双重危机乘数"相互强化的机制，并扩展框架以考虑企业、行业和地理的异质性。

title: Implications of Inflation Dynamics for Monetary Policy Strategies
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

detail.title: Implications of Inflation Dynamics for Monetary Policy Strategies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-072, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.072]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper considers robust monetary policy strategies both in situations of low demand and low inflation and when economic developments pose a tradeoff between inflation and output stabilization.  We proceed in two parts.  First, our quantitative analysis suggests that asymmetric average inflation targeting can provide modest benefits over other inflation-targeting strategies when the risks associated with the effective lower bound remain significant.  Second, motivated by the recent experience of persistent supply shocks and rapid increases in inflation, we describe the main qualitative features of optimal policy in circumstances when the objectives of stabilizing inflation and economic activity conflict.  We find that monetary policy may allow inflation to depart from the target in response to certain supply shocks or in cases when sectoral dynamics are relevant, but that it should be ready to respond forcefully and expeditiously to large inflationary shocks or if inflation expectations are at risk of becoming unanchored.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在低需求低通胀环境以及通胀与产出稳定存在权衡时的稳健货币政策策略。研究发现：当有效下限风险显著时，非对称平均通胀目标制能提供适度优势；面对供给冲击时，货币政策可允许通胀暂时偏离目标，但对大规模通胀冲击或通胀预期脱锚风险需强力快速应对。
AI.research_question: 在不同经济环境下（低需求低通胀 vs 通胀与产出稳定权衡），什么是稳健的货币政策策略？
AI.motivation: 应对经济环境变化带来的政策挑战：一是有效下限约束下的低通胀风险，二是供给冲击导致通胀与产出稳定的权衡困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通胀目标制框架，结合有效下限约束理论和供给冲击下的政策权衡理论。
AI.method: 采用两部分分析：第一部分进行定量分析比较不同通胀目标策略，第二部分进行定性分析描述供给冲击下的最优政策特征。
AI.findings: 1. 当有效下限风险显著时，非对称平均通胀目标制比其他通胀目标策略有适度优势；2. 面对供给冲击，货币政策可允许通胀暂时偏离目标，但需对大规模通胀冲击或通胀预期脱锚风险做出强力快速反应。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了在复杂经济环境下（有效下限约束和供给冲击）的货币政策理论框架，明确了不同情境下的最优政策反应函数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行提供了具体的政策操作指南：在低通胀环境下采用非对称平均通胀目标，在供给冲击下保持政策灵活性但坚守通胀预期锚定。

title: Türkiye's Homemade Crises
affiliations: Bilkent University - Department of Economics and Yale School of Management

detail.title: Türkiye's Homemade Crises

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Türkiye's response to post-pandemic inflation is a cautionary tale of how political pressure for low interest rates can create macroeconomic instabilities. While central banks worldwide raised interest rates to combat inflation in 2021-2023, Turkish authorities pursued the opposite strategy: cutting real rates to deeply negative levels while implementing financial engineering tools, FX interventions, and financial repression to stabilize markets. The centerpiece was a novel FX-protected deposit scheme (KKM) that guaranteed depositors against currency depreciation, shifting exchange rate risk to the government balance sheet. We provide a detailed account of this policy experiment and develop a theoretical model focusing on how KKM functions and creates vulnerabilities. Our model reveals that pressure to keep interest rates below inflation-targeting levels can lead to an interconnected destabilizing sequence. Low rates generate inflation, current account deficits, and exchange rate depreciation. KKM provides partial stabilization by effectively raising rates for savers while maintaining low rates for borrowers. However, this creates growing contingent fiscal burdens and vulnerability to self-fulfilling currency and sovereign debt crises. This explains additional policies adopted including capital flow management, financial repression, and return to orthodox monetary policy. As central banks worldwide face renewed pressure to set lower policy rates, Türkiye's experience illustrates the consequences.

AI.tldr: 土耳其应对疫情后通胀的政策实验表明，政治压力下的低利率政策会导致宏观经济不稳定。土耳其通过负实际利率、金融工程工具和外汇保护存款计划(KKM)来稳定市场，但这创造了财政负担和危机脆弱性。

title: Evaluating Macroeconomic Outcomes Under Asymmetries: Expectations Matter
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

detail.title: Evaluating Macroeconomic Outcomes Under Asymmetries: Expectations Matter

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-079, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.079]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Asymmetries play an important role in many macroeconomic models. We show that assumptions on household and firm expectations play a key role in determining the effects of these asymmetries on macroeconomic outcomes. If households and firms have perfect foresight and hence do not account for the possibility of future shocks, then the implied longer-run averages and distributions for unemployment and inflation can differ significantly from their rational expectations counterparts.  We first derive this result analytically under either an asymmetric monetary policy rule or a nonlinear Phillips curve before numerically examining some of the key nonlinearities featured in the recent literature.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究发现，家庭和企业预期假设在决定不对称性对宏观经济结果的影响中起关键作用。当经济主体具有完美预见性而非理性预期时，失业率和通胀的长期平均值和分布会显著不同。
AI.research_question: 不对称性假设下，家庭和企业预期如何影响宏观经济结果？
AI.motivation: 不对称性在宏观经济模型中很重要，但预期假设的作用尚未充分研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 完美预见性 vs 理性预期理论，不对称货币政策规则，非线性菲利普斯曲线
AI.method: 先进行理论分析推导，然后对近期文献中的关键非线性特征进行数值模拟
AI.findings: 当经济主体具有完美预见性时，失业率和通胀的长期平均值和分布与理性预期情况显著不同

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于不同预期假设下政策效果差异的重要启示

title: When Tails Are Heavy: The Benefits of Variance-Targeted, Non-Gaussian, Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimation of GARCH Models
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: When Tails Are Heavy: The Benefits of Variance-Targeted, Non-Gaussian, Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimation of GARCH Models

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-075, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.075]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: In heavy-tailed cases, variance targeting the Student's-t estimator proposed in Bollerslev (1987) for the linear GARCH model is shown to be robust to density misspecification, just like the popular Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimator (QMLE). The resulting Variance-Targeted, Non-Gaussian, Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimator (VTNGQMLE) is shown to possess a stable limit, albeit one that is highly non-Gaussian, with an ill-defined variance. The rate of convergence to this non-standard limit is slow relative √n and dependent upon unknown parameters. Fortunately, the sub-sample bootstrap is applicable, given a carefully constructed normalization. Surprisingly, both Monte Carlo experiments and empirical applications reveal VTNGQMLE to sizably outperform QMLE and other performance-enhancing (relative to QMLE) alternatives. In an empirical application, VTNGQMLE is applied to VIX (option-implied volatility of the S&P 500 Index). The resulting GARCH variance estimates are then used to forecast option-implied volatility of volatility (VVIX), thus demonstrating a link between historical volatility of VIX and risk-neutral volatility-of-volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对厚尾分布的方差目标学生t估计器(VTNGQMLE)，用于线性GARCH模型。该估计器对密度误设具有鲁棒性，收敛速度慢于√n且依赖于未知参数，但蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用显示其性能显著优于QMLE和其他替代方法。
AI.research_question: 方差目标学生t估计器(VTNGQMLE)在厚尾情况下对线性GARCH模型的估计性能如何？
AI.motivation: 在金融时间序列分析中，厚尾分布是常见现象，需要开发对密度误设具有鲁棒性的估计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bollerslev(1987)提出的线性GARCH模型，结合方差目标方法和学生t分布假设。
AI.method: 使用方差目标非高斯拟最大似然估计器(VTNGQMLE)，并应用子样本自助法进行推断。
AI.findings: VTNGQMLE具有稳定的极限分布，但收敛速度慢于√n且依赖于未知参数；在蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用中显著优于QMLE和其他替代方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了VTNGQMLE对密度误设的鲁棒性，并分析了其非标准极限分布特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融时间序列分析提供了性能更优的估计方法，在VIX和VVIX预测中展示了实际应用价值。

title: Local Estimation for Option Pricing: Improving Forecasts with Market State Information
affiliations: and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Local Estimation for Option Pricing: Improving Forecasts with Market State Information

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2025-076, 2025[10.17016/FEDS.2025.076]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We propose a novel estimation framework for option pricing models that incorporates local, state-dependent information to improve out-of-sample forecasting performance. Rather than modifying the underlying option pricing model, such as the Heston-Nandi GARCH or the Heston stochastic volatility framework, we introduce a local M-estimation approach that conditions on key state variables including VIX, realized volatility, and time. Our method reweights historical observations based on their relevance to current market conditions, using kernel functions with bandwidths selected via a validation procedure. This adaptive estimation improves the model’s responsiveness to evolving dynamics while maintaining tractability. Empirically, we show that local estimators substantially outperform traditional non-local approaches in forecasting near-term option implied volatilities. The improvements are particularly pronounced in low-volatility environments and across the cross-section of options. The local estimators also outperform the non-local estimators in explaining future option returns. Our findings suggest that local information, when properly incorporated into the estimation process, can enhance the accuracy and robustness of option pricing models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的期权定价模型估计框架，通过结合局部、状态依赖信息来改进样本外预测性能。该方法使用局部M估计方法，基于VIX、已实现波动率和时间等关键状态变量对历史观测值进行重新加权，显著提升了短期期权隐含波动率的预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合局部状态依赖信息来改进期权定价模型的样本外预测性能？
AI.motivation: 传统期权定价模型在预测性能上存在局限，特别是在应对市场条件变化时缺乏适应性。需要开发能够更好捕捉市场动态变化的估计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于局部M估计理论，结合核函数和验证程序选择带宽参数，构建状态依赖的加权估计框架。
AI.method: 提出局部M估计方法，使用VIX、已实现波动率和时间作为状态变量，通过核函数对历史观测值进行重新加权，带宽参数通过验证程序选择。
AI.findings: 局部估计器在预测短期期权隐含波动率方面显著优于传统非局部方法，特别是在低波动环境中和跨期权横截面上表现更佳；在解释未来期权回报方面也优于非局部估计器。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了状态依赖的局部估计理论框架，为期权定价模型的适应性估计提供了新的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提高了期权定价模型的预测准确性和稳健性，为实际交易和风险管理提供了更可靠的定价工具，特别在低波动市场环境中效果显著。

title: The Reinforcing Effects Between Flying as a Core Service and Partners Within a Local Loyalty Programme

detail.title: The Reinforcing Effects Between Flying as a Core Service and Partners Within a Local Loyalty Programme

declarations.declarationOfInterest: not applicable

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how multi-vendor loyalty programs influence customer behavior, specifically within the context of an airline's program and its various partners. It examines cross-buying activities between flying (the core service) and partners across different categories, such as other airlines, car hire, hotels, and less complementary services like credit cards and fuel vendors. Utilizing a generalized additive model (GAM) analysis on data from the Voyager loyalty program, the research tests hypotheses related to the impact of partner category fit, bonus awards, and membership duration on core service usage and cross-buying. The findings reveal complex and varied relationships between partner categories and core service engagement, highlighting that less complementary partners exhibit a strong positive and nearly linear relationship with core service usage. The study also explores the effect of bonus miles and membership duration on customer loyalty and purchasing patterns across the different partner types.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨多供应商忠诚度计划如何影响客户行为，特别关注航空公司的忠诚度计划及其各类合作伙伴。研究发现非互补性合作伙伴与核心服务使用之间存在强烈的正向线性关系。

title: Global Financial Turmoil: Examining its Risks and Ripple Effect on Financial Systems
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics,  and

detail.title: Global Financial Turmoil: Examining its Risks and Ripple Effect on Financial Systems
detail.abstract: Over the past two decades, the global economic landscape has faced substantial turmoil, marked by major events such as the 2007 financial crisis and the ongoing challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. This paper aims to theoretically clarify the consequences of the global financial crisis on the developing economy of Kosovo, with a particular focus on its financial system, and to propose potential future reforms in this sector. Using a comparative analysis of different time periods, specifically examining the financial crisis from 2008 to 2023 in Kosovo, the study reveals that the global economic crisis has significantly impacted Kosovo's economy. This is evident in the pronounced fluctuations in key macroeconomic indicators, including gross domestic product (GDP), trade balance, consumer price index (CPI), unemployment rates, remittances, and foreign direct investment (FDI) during this period. The findings suggest that two fundamental factors-the low level of economic integration and the government's shift in priorities towards capital investments-have mitigated the crisis's impact on Kosovo. The paper also highlights the ongoing challenges of inflation and emphasizes the need for strategies to ensure resilience and sustainable economic prosperity in the future.

title: Between Prohibition and Practice: Institutional AI Policy Contradictions
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Between Prohibition and Practice: Institutional AI Policy Contradictions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: Declaration: AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) was used for research organization, literature synthesis, and manuscript development. All conceptual frameworks, arguments, and conclusions represent the author's independent scholarly work. Original research not previously published elsewhere Ethical Compliance: Research conducted in accordance with standard academic ethical guidelines
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding received for this research

detail.abstract: This study examines the emerging contradictions between institutional AI policies and actual AI integration practices across academic institutions. Through mixed-methods analysis of institutional policies, usage patterns, and administrative preparedness, we document significant gaps between stated AI governance principles and their implementation across different institutional stakeholders. Our findings reveal that while 67-92% of students report AI use despite prohibition policies, academic institutions simultaneously rely on AI for peer review, administrative functions, and research operations. We argue that current AI governance frameworks reflect institutional adaptation challenges rather than coherent policy design, creating professional preparation gaps that may disadvantage graduates in AI-integrated career environments. The study concludes that effective AI governance requires institutional alignment between educational practices and professional preparation objectives.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了学术机构AI政策与实际应用之间的显著矛盾，发现尽管67-92%的学生在禁令政策下仍使用AI，但机构自身也依赖AI进行同行评审、行政职能和研究操作，表明当前AI治理框架反映了机构适应挑战而非连贯政策设计。

title: Chapter 1. Association between Sleep Problems and Consumption of Caffeine and Nicotine
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - College of Human Ecology

detail.title: Chapter 1. Association between Sleep Problems and Consumption of Caffeine and Nicotine

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the bidirectional relationship between insomnia symptoms and the consumption of caffeine and nicotine using nationally representative, longitudinal data from the NielsenIQ Consumer Panel and the Annual Ailments, Health, and Wellness Survey (2011–2020). While prior research has primarily examined unidirectional effects, this chapter explores reciprocal dynamics between sleep problems and substance use. Fixed-effects regression models reveal that households purchasing more caffeine and cigarettes are more likely to report insomnia symptoms, and conversely, households experiencing insomnia symptoms purchase greater amounts of these substances. The association is more robust for nicotine, with cigarette purchases and insomnia symptoms reinforcing one another even after controlling for household fixed effects. By contrast, the relationship between caffeine purchases and insomnia symptoms is weaker within households, suggesting consumption patterns may be influenced by unobserved individual-level factors. These findings highlight the cyclical interaction between lifestyle behaviors and sleep health, underscoring the importance of addressing both sides of the relationship in future research and policy aimed at improving sleep and reducing substance-related harms.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用全国代表性纵向数据，通过固定效应回归模型发现失眠症状与咖啡因、尼古丁消费之间存在双向关系。尼古丁与失眠的相互强化作用更强，而咖啡因与失眠的关系在控制家庭固定效应后较弱。

title: Authority versus Trust: Rethinking Agricultural Extension through Community Credibility
affiliations: and Thai Nguyen University of Agriculture and Forestry

detail.title: Authority versus Trust: Rethinking Agricultural Extension through Community Credibility
detail.abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of different stakeholders in promoting the adoption of safe pesticide practices in rural farming communities. We implemented a randomized controlled trial with 788 paddy-farming households in Thai Binh province, Vietnam. Training on safe pesticide practices was delivered to random peer farmers, official village leaders, and credible farmers who act as key channels for information diffusion within local communities. The results indicate that all three stakeholders generated significant spillover effects in the short term. However, only credible farmers maintained a lasting impact in the long term. Our heterogeneity analysis further reveal that credible farmers are highly effective in promoting proper pesticide practices among females, farmers with higher education, and larger farm owners. These findings underscore the importance of leveraging credible community members in agricultural extension and provide empirical evidence for designing sustainable agriculture policies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验发现，在越南农村社区推广安全农药实践中，可信农民比同行农民和官方村领导能产生更持久的长期影响，特别是在女性、高学历和大农场主群体中效果显著。
AI.research_question: 不同利益相关者（同行农民、官方村领导、可信农民）在促进农村社区安全农药实践采纳方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 了解哪种类型的社区成员能够最有效地推广可持续农业实践，为农业推广政策设计提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息扩散理论和社区影响力理论，探讨不同类型社区成员在农业技术推广中的作用。
AI.method: 在越南太平省对788个水稻种植户进行的随机对照试验，分别对同行农民、官方村领导和可信农民进行安全农药实践培训。
AI.findings: 所有三类利益相关者在短期内都产生了显著的溢出效应，但只有可信农民在长期内保持了持久影响；可信农民在女性、高学历和大农场主群体中特别有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 为社区影响力理论提供了实证支持，明确了可信农民在农业技术扩散中的独特作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业推广政策设计提供了具体指导，建议优先利用可信社区成员来促进可持续农业实践。

title: Stardust and Supply Chains: From Cosmic Atoms to Global Commerce -The Hidden Connections Behind Everything We Consume
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Stardust and Supply Chains: From Cosmic Atoms to Global Commerce -The Hidden Connections Behind Everything We Consume
detail.abstract: Human beings, along with the products we enjoy, are made up of the same chemical elements produced in stars. Current economies rely upon complex, global supply chains which aggregate, refine, manufacture and distribute those elements as products. In this paper, I contend that the idea of stardust (i.e., nucleosynthesis and the shared cosmic origin of matter) represents a useful metaphor and an analytical approach to understanding the largely invisible, interconnected networks of contemporary commerce. By combining astrophysical facts about matter with the fields of economics, supply chain analysis, sustainability, and branding, this paper highlights how cosmic storylines can enhance business strategy-with particular reference to the areas of sustainability, resilience, the circular economy, and narrative. I used recent empirical data on global trade, battery-metal production and the frequency of global supply-chain disruptions, and e-waste, and then explore actionable implications for business education and practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将星尘（核合成和物质的共同宇宙起源）作为理解当代商业中不可见、相互关联网络的隐喻和分析方法，结合天体物理事实与经济学、供应链分析、可持续性和品牌建设，探讨宇宙叙事如何增强商业战略，特别是在可持续性、韧性、循环经济和叙事方面。
AI.research_question: 星尘概念如何作为隐喻和分析方法来理解当代商业的相互关联网络？
AI.motivation: 人类和产品都由恒星产生的相同化学元素组成，当前经济依赖复杂全球供应链来聚集、精炼、制造和分销这些元素作为产品。
AI.theoretical_framework: 天体物理学（核合成、物质宇宙起源）、经济学、供应链分析、可持续性理论、品牌叙事理论
AI.method: 使用全球贸易、电池金属生产、全球供应链中断频率和电子垃圾的最新实证数据
AI.findings: 宇宙叙事可以增强商业战略，特别是在可持续性、韧性、循环经济和叙事方面
AI.theory_contributions: 提出星尘作为理解当代商业网络的新隐喻和分析框架，整合了天体物理学与商业研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业教育和实践提供可操作的启示，特别是在可持续发展和供应链管理方面

title: Sale Pricing and Demand Dynamics

detail.title: Sale Pricing and Demand Dynamics

publicationDetails.detailsText: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Kilts Center at Chicago Booth Marketing Data Center Paper Series

detail.abstract: I study imperfect price discrimination in markets where consumers can store goods for future consumption. I develop a dynamic model in which consumer decisions incorporate inventory costs. I show that when sellers know the distribution of inventory costs, they can discriminate between consumers with heterogeneous price sensitivities. Using store-level data, I estimate the model parameters and identify the share of less price-sensitive consumers who do not store versus more price-sensitive consumers who take advantage of lower sale price. I find that (i) static models understate ownprice elasticities by up to 50 percent, (ii) storing consumers exhibit higher cross-price elasticities, highlighting the primacy of price over brand loyalty, (iii) sellers increase profits by up to 10 percent when combining volume discount pricing with inter-temporal pricing strategy, and (iv) while sale price primarily benefit storers, incorporating inventory costs substantially tempers these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了消费者可以储存商品的市场中的不完全价格歧视问题。通过建立包含库存成本的动态模型，发现当卖家了解库存成本分布时，可以对价格敏感度不同的消费者进行歧视定价。实证分析显示：静态模型低估自身价格弹性达50%；储存型消费者交叉价格弹性更高；结合数量折扣和跨期定价策略可提升利润10%；虽然促销价主要惠及储存者，但库存成本显著削弱了这些收益。
AI.research_question: 在消费者可以储存商品的市场中，卖家如何通过了解库存成本分布来实施不完全价格歧视？
AI.motivation: 传统价格歧视理论往往忽略消费者储存行为对定价策略的影响，特别是在动态环境中库存成本如何影响消费者的购买决策和卖家的定价能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态定价理论、不完全价格歧视理论、消费者储存行为理论、库存成本模型
AI.method: 建立包含库存成本的动态模型，使用店铺级数据进行参数估计，识别不同价格敏感度消费者的行为模式
AI.findings: 1) 静态模型低估自身价格弹性达50%；2) 储存型消费者交叉价格弹性更高，价格比品牌忠诚更重要；3) 结合数量折扣和跨期定价策略可提升利润10%；4) 库存成本显著削弱促销价带来的收益
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了不完全价格歧视理论，将消费者储存行为和库存成本纳入动态定价框架，为理解跨期消费决策提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供了更精确的定价策略建议，特别是如何结合数量折扣和跨期定价来最大化利润，同时考虑了库存成本对消费者行为的影响

title: Achieving Sustainable Value in the Age of Big Data: A Human-Centered Approach to Data Project Success

detail.title: Achieving Sustainable Value in the Age of Big Data: A Human-Centered Approach to Data Project Success

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Organizations today are pouring time and money into data projects, hoping to gain new efficiencies and valuable insights. But despite all the advancements in technology, many of these efforts still fall short of expectations.. The real issue comes from outdated management approaches that focus too much on technical outputs and not enough on the people and strategic value behind the work. This paper introduces the 4P Framework-Purpose, People, Process, and Platform-as a more human-centered way forward. By keeping these four elements in balance, organizations can better handle the challenges of today's complex data environment.This approach moves beyond simply building a platform to focus on creating lasting change, significantly increasing the chances of delivering real, sustainable business value. We conclude with practical guidance for leaders and suggestions for future research.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了4P框架（目的、人员、流程、平台）作为更人性化的数据管理方法，强调平衡这四个要素以应对复杂数据环境的挑战，超越单纯的技术平台建设，专注于创造持久变革，从而显著提高交付真实、可持续业务价值的机会。
AI.research_question: 如何通过更人性化的管理方法提高数据项目的成功率和业务价值？
AI.motivation: 尽管技术和投资不断增加，许多数据项目仍然未能达到预期效果，问题根源在于过时的管理方法过于关注技术输出，而忽视了人员和战略价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 4P框架（目的、人员、流程、平台）作为理论基础，强调这四个要素的平衡协调。
AI.method: 概念性框架开发，基于对现有数据项目管理问题的分析。
AI.findings: 通过平衡4P框架的四个要素，组织能够更好地应对复杂数据环境的挑战，超越单纯的技术平台建设，创造持久变革，显著提高业务价值交付的成功率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了4P框架作为数据管理的新理论视角，强调人性化管理和战略价值的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供了实用的指导建议，帮助他们在实际工作中应用4P框架来提高数据项目的成功率。

title: Should Central Banks Consider Inequality in Monetary Policy? Evidence from Quantitative Easing
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Should Central Banks Consider Inequality in Monetary Policy? Evidence from Quantitative Easing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants or ethical approval requirements.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether central banks should account for the distributional consequences of monetary policy-specifically wealth, income, credit, and regional inequalities, when designing and evaluating Quantitative Easing (QE). Initially introduced as a temporary response to the 2008 Global Financial Crisis, QE has since become a central feature of monetary policy in advanced economies. While credited with stabilising markets and preventing deflationary spirals, evidence indicates that QE has significant distributional effects. Using the United States as the primary case study, complemented by comparative insights from the Euro area and Japan, the paper analyses five transmission channels: asset prices, income flows, credit allocation, labour markets, and regional disparities. Descriptive evidence and secondary literature show that QE disproportionately benefits wealthier households through asset price inflation and preferential credit access, while offering limited gains to lower-income groups and weaker regions. These outcomes reduce QE's effectiveness by dampening aggregate demand and simultaneously raise concerns over central bank independence and legitimacy. The paper contributes by integrating multiple channels into a unified framework and linking them explicitly to debates on monetary governance. Policy implications include Distributional Impact Assessments, stronger communication strategies, closer monetary-fiscal coordination, and longer-term innovations such as Green QE and central bank digital currencies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨央行在设计量化宽松政策时是否应考虑其分配效应，研究发现QE通过资产价格、信贷分配等渠道加剧财富不平等，建议进行分配影响评估和改进政策框架。
AI.research_question: 央行在设计评估量化宽松政策时是否应该考虑其对财富、收入、信贷和区域不平等的分配后果？
AI.motivation: 量化宽松最初作为应对2008年金融危机的临时措施，现已成为发达经济体货币政策的核心特征，但证据表明QE具有显著的分配效应，可能影响政策有效性和央行独立性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通过五个传导渠道分析QE的分配效应：资产价格、收入流动、信贷分配、劳动力市场和区域差异。
AI.method: 以美国为主要案例研究，辅以欧元区和日本的比较分析，结合描述性证据和二手文献进行综合分析。
AI.findings: QE通过资产价格通胀和优先信贷获取不成比例地惠及富裕家庭，对低收入群体和弱势地区的收益有限，这些结果降低了QE的总需求刺激效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多个传导渠道整合到统一框架中，并明确将其与货币政策治理辩论联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策建议包括分配影响评估、强化沟通策略、加强货币财政协调，以及长期创新如绿色QE和央行数字货币。

title: Simulation-optimization Approach for Emergency Surgery Allocation
affiliations: , Fuzhou University, Central South University and KU Leuven

detail.title: Simulation-optimization Approach for Emergency Surgery Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: A sudden surge in emergency surgeries exacerbates congestion issues within the operating room (OR), which is a critical and limited medical resource. Depending solely on human judgment for emergency surgery allocation decisions may intensify OR congestion, leading to possible postponements or cancellations of both emergency and elective surgeries. In the worst case, the patient may need a second transfer if the initially allocated hospital lacks capacity, causing further delays in treatment. To mitigate the abovementioned risks, we develop a stochastic mixed-integer programming model for emergency patient allocation under a hybrid emergency surgery strategy. Then, we design a simulation-optimization approach to evaluate the expected maximum potential capacity for accepting emergency surgeries. Our approach facilitates a prompt decision-making process in urgent cases, enabling decision makers to make more reasonable choices swiftly. Specifically, we propose an improved sample average approximation method with a stopping rule for the single-hospital case, and integrate it into the optimal computing budget allocation algorithm to accommodate the multi-hospital settings. To demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithms, we conduct experiments based on real data from a local 3A hospital in China. Our results illustrate the robustness of the proposed methods by a sensitivity analysis of the internal factor (the overtime length), the external factor (the release time of emergency patients) and the expected elective surgery durations. Moreover, we emphasize the benefits of collaborative decision making in the multi-hospital setting for emergency surgery allocation.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个随机混合整数规划模型和仿真优化方法，用于在混合急诊手术策略下分配急诊患者，以缓解手术室拥堵问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在急诊手术激增的情况下优化急诊患者分配决策，以缓解手术室拥堵并减少手术延误？
AI.motivation: 急诊手术激增会加剧手术室拥堵，仅依靠人工判断进行分配决策可能导致急诊和择期手术的推迟或取消，在最坏情况下患者可能需要二次转院，延误治疗。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机混合整数规划、仿真优化、样本平均近似法、最优计算预算分配算法
AI.method: 提出改进的带停止规则的样本平均近似法用于单医院场景，并将其集成到最优计算预算分配算法中以适应多医院设置，基于中国某三甲医院真实数据进行实验验证。
AI.findings: 提出的方法在内部因素（加班时长）、外部因素（急诊患者释放时间）和预期择期手术时长等敏感性分析中表现出鲁棒性，多医院协作决策在急诊手术分配中具有显著优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了针对急诊手术分配的随机混合整数规划模型和仿真优化方法，提出了改进的样本平均近似法和多医院场景下的集成算法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为急诊手术分配提供了快速决策支持工具，帮助决策者在紧急情况下做出更合理的分配选择，减少手术延误和患者二次转院风险。

title: Leader of the Pack: A Theoretical Model of Signaling Effects of a Large Agent in a Global Game of Regime Change with Risk Aversion and Network Effects

detail.title: Leader of the Pack: A Theoretical Model of Signaling Effects of a Large Agent in a Global Game of Regime Change with Risk Aversion and Network Effects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding

detail.abstract: This paper extends global games theory to analyze regime change with a large external agent, heterogeneous risk aversion, and network effects. I develop a framework where one large agent (foreign power or military) interacts strategically with a continuum of small agents (citizens) embedded in social networks. The model generates three main theoretical results: (1) heterogeneous CARA risk aversion creates differential revolutionary thresholds across social groups, with youth participating first, (2) a spectral condition ρ(A)•φ > 1 determines whether local protests cascade nationally, providing a tractable criterion for revolutionary spread, and (3) the large agent's signaling effect can coordinate citizen actions even with inferior information, explaining external intervention effectiveness. The framework yields testable predictions about protest dynamics, network topology effects, and the "leader of the pack" phenomenon where visible actions by powerful actors trigger cascades.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了全球博弈理论，分析包含大型外部参与者、异质风险规避和网络效应的政权更迭。模型显示：异质风险规避导致不同社会群体革命阈值差异（青年首先参与）；谱条件ρ(A)•φ>1决定局部抗议是否全国蔓延；大型参与者的信号效应能协调公民行动。

AI.method: 理论建模框架，包含一个大型参与者（外国势力或军队）与连续体小参与者（公民）在网络环境中的战略互动

title: Food Security under Climate Stress - with Freer and Greener Trade
affiliations: World Trade Institute

detail.title: Food Security under Climate Stress - with Freer and Greener Trade

declarations.funderStatement: Research for this chapter was partly funded by the MATS Project (Making Agricultural Trade Sustainable), as a part of the European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement no 101000751 MATS (https://sustainable-agri-trade.eu/)

detail.abstract: The deadlock in multilateral trade and climate negotiations means that governments may ‘talk the talks’ for many more years, and in many international fora. Trade ministries refuse to negotiate ‘green’ subsidies. Climate ministries refuse to set binding climate footprint reduction standards and procedures. For observers from an academic vantage point this hardly comes as a surprise. Six consecutive ministerial meetings on climate and on trade, respectively, have failed to actually negotiate any climate change-resilient agrifood rules, standards or procedures. The setback on record for almost all Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) adds further proof of the present paralysis. Non-protectionist agricultural policy reforms and market access improvements for more climate- and trade-friendly food security have become a remote target. In 2023, the number of people on the brink of famine almost doubled to over 700,000. Farmer protection, ‘green’ subsidies and trade restrictions such as ‘mirror clauses’ for imports of ‘like’ products upset the multilateral apple cart. Governments refuse to switch into negotiation mode for less production subsidies, price support, stockpile management, safeguards and food dumping – let alone in-built climate footprint and mutual recognition of equivalent production and processing methods. Climate fatigue prevents negotiations for sustainable food trade and for better trade and investment rules. Policymakers ignore sustainability impact assessments of old and new tools and measures designed to address new challenges to global and climate-smart food security. Scholars, stakeholders, traders and investors looking for more food secure ventures can no longer rely on enforceable rules. Most governments fail to address new issues. Which international governance reforms can save us from grilling on our own barbecues? Which climate commitments and which multilateral trade rules prevent climate-friendly agricultural trade from thriving? For lawyers, the main challenge is navigating the abyss between the differentiation obligation of the Paris Agreement and the non-discrimination mantra of the multilateral trading scheme enshrined in World Trade Organization (WTO) Law. Without ‘greener’ food trade rules, domestic producers subject to carbon taxes lose market shares and must be protected with subsidies and import regulations preventing carbon leakage. Therefore, our insider advice in this complex impasse is for climate advocates to endow their proposals with reciprocal, scheduled trade preferences based on mutually agreed equivalent, sustainable climate footprint reduction schemes – including agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了多边贸易与气候谈判的僵局，指出贸易部门拒绝谈判"绿色"补贴，气候部门拒绝设定有约束力的碳足迹标准。作者建议气候倡导者应在提案中加入基于相互认可等效可持续碳足迹减排计划的互惠贸易优惠。

AI.motivation: 多边贸易和气候谈判陷入僵局，六次部长级会议均未能就气候变化适应型农业食品规则达成协议，可持续发展目标进展受挫，饥饿人口增加，需要寻找解决方案。

AI.method: 基于对多边谈判僵局的观察分析，结合法律和政策分析框架。
AI.findings: 当前谈判僵局导致无法制定可执行的规则，政府未能解决新问题，国内生产商因碳税而失去市场份额，需要补贴和进口管制来防止碳泄漏。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了协调巴黎协定差异化义务与WTO非歧视原则的理论框架，为气候与贸易政策整合提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议气候倡导者在提案中加入基于相互认可等效可持续碳足迹减排计划的互惠贸易优惠，为解决谈判僵局提供具体方案。

title: Another Round of Pseudo-Deflation, Policy Endogeneity and the Risk of Overreaction
affiliations: Peking University

detail.title: Another Round of Pseudo-Deflation, Policy Endogeneity and the Risk of Overreaction
detail.abstract: Published on August 9, 2012, onSina Finance, Dong Xian'an's article predicts a likely economic slowdown over the next decade, arguing that structural constraints will endogenously extend China's infrastructure saturation. It emphasizes policy endogeneity, warning against overreacting to economic signals and noting lagged deflation risk assessments as a critical timing error. Early Q1 data warnings could have curbed a negative domestic-external demand feedback loop. Long-term, China's reliance on imported soybeans and crude oil has shaped its economy, with overheated demand since 2000 worsening price-based terms of trade, compressing profits while favoring resource exporters.

title: State-Sponsored Knowledge Contribution to Standardization: The Case of Telecommunication
affiliations: Eindhoven University of Technology (TUE) - Department of Industrial Engineering and Innovation Sciences, Eindhoven University of Technology (TUE), Eindhoven University of Technology (TUE) - Department of Industrial Engineering and Innovation Sciences and Delft University of Technology - Faculty of Technology, Policy and Management

detail.title: State-Sponsored Knowledge Contribution to Standardization: The Case of Telecommunication
detail.abstract:
From the internet to mobile telephony, some of the most influential industry standards have emerged from state-funded research.

Public investment in defense and scientific programs has repeatedly generated the foundational knowledge later codified into global standards. Yet, despite qualitative accounts of these contributions, systematic empirical evidence on the state's role in standard development remains scarce. The existing literature continues to emphasize private-sector actors as the primary source of standard-relevant knowledge.

This study addresses the need to understand whether, and to what extent, the state contributes to standard development by examining the case of telecommunications. Specifically, we investigate to what extent state-sponsored knowledge input is relied upon by core standard-relevant contributions in telecoms.

We identify core standard-related contributions using network analysis of standard-related patents. Subsequently, by employing a Logit/Probit framework, we assess whether the core standard-related patents exhibit a greater reliance on state-sponsored science relative to other standard-related patents. The analysis shows that core telecommunication standardization contributions rely more heavily on state-sponsored science than comparable contributions.

This challenges the dominant view of standards as industry-driven by revealing that state-sponsored research is structurally embedded in their development. It reframes public investment as strategic rather than incidental, showing that state-sponsored research actively enables the technologies anchoring global telecom standards. These findings also carry implications for technological sovereignty and industrial policy. States that invest in foundational research are better positioned to shape standards, markets, and long-term innovation trajectories.

detail.abstract: Purpose-This paper, in light of the theory of planned behavior, aims to analyze the factors that have an impact on entrepreneurial intentions among students in Kosovo. Design/methodology/approach-A structured questionnaire is administered online for data collection, and the analysis is conducted using structural equation modeling. Findings-The authors find that in the context of Kosovo, personal attitudes, subjective norms and perceived behavioral control significantly impact entrepreneurial intention among students. However, the entrepreneurial education survey respondents received was unrelated to entrepreneurial intention of students in Kosovo. Originality/value-The authors contribute to the literature regarding the role of entrepreneurial education on entrepreneurial intention among students and graduates. In addition, the authors provide new evidence regarding the impact of personal attitudes, subjective norms and perceived behavioral control on entrepreneurial intention in the context of a transition economy. Finally, the authors offer recommendations to educational institutions and policymakers concerning the appropriate design of entrepreneurial education.

detail.abstract: This study presents a structured literature review of operating room (OR) planning and scheduling, focusing on the integration of elective (EL) and non-elective (non-EL) surgical demand. Our objectives are threefold: (i) to provide an updated overview of recent developments; (ii) to examine the disruptions and lessons from the COVID-19 pandemic and (iii) to classify the literature thematically, identifying research trends and future research directions. Drawing on articles identified through database searches and citation analyses, we examine the literature across key dimensions: problem settings, patient characteristics and emergency (EM) surgery policies, decision-making levels, modeling approaches, related facilities, objective functions, constraints, uncertainty, methods, analysis and practical applicability. Our work offers actionable insights for both researchers and practitioners and outlines some promising future research opportunities.

title: Preference Reversals: A Meta-Analysis

detail.title: Preference Reversals: A Meta-Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no potential conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, and/or publication of this preprint.

detail.abstract: Preference reversal (PR) refers to the phenomenon in which individuals express inconsistent preference orderings over the same options when evaluated using different yet formally equivalent elicitation methods. This meta-analysis integrates 79 studies, covering 175 experiments or treatments and 3,198 unique scenarios derived from 12,852 participants. As expected, the analysis revealed a robust asymmetric pattern of PR, accompanied by substantial variation across study contexts, suggesting that this pattern is susceptible to moderating factors or study designs. Several idiosyncratic moderators---including probability and payoff structures---were identified that help explain the conditions under which this asymmetry is more or less likely to emerge.

title: Keeping Journalists in the Dark: 'Citation Cartels' Limit Public Knowledge
affiliations: Nonpartisan Education Group

detail.title: Keeping Journalists in the Dark: 'Citation Cartels' Limit Public Knowledge
detail.abstract: The public relies on journalists to learn about and share academic research. Public knowledge can be undermined, however, when academics try to influence what research journalists cover or limit the "acceptable debate" about an issue. This influence can be achieved through "citation cartels," where sympathetic researchers cite and reference one another and ignore or dismiss the high-quality research of others that reach different conclusions. Citation cartels belittle research they disagree with, rather than refute it.

title: On-Site Consumption and the Cannabis Farm: Can Craft Cannabis Replicate the Success of Craft Beer?
affiliations: Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge - Paul M. Hebert Law Center

detail.title: On-Site Consumption and the Cannabis Farm: Can Craft Cannabis Replicate the Success of Craft Beer?
detail.abstract:
The cannabis industry’s predicted “Green Rush” has turned out to be a mirage.  Cannabis firms of all types and sizes are struggling to maintain profitability in the face of oversupply, stagnant demand, and shifting regulatory burdens.  This is particularly true for small businesses in the cannabis industry, who cannot take on losses for a sustained period.  And it is true for cannabis cultivators, whose input costs remain high despite falling prices for wholesale cannabis.  State regulators, for their part, have created permitting schemes that issue licenses on the assumption that a license is a golden ticket to profitability.  But that has proven to be a false assumption, and states must now focus on adopting regulations that foster a sustainable business environment for small-scale operators and cultivators.

This article proposes a simple reform to address these challenges: permit cultivators to open their doors to the public for direct sale and consumption.  Similar reforms that were applied to the beer industry are largely responsible for the craft beer revolution in the United States, and this article argues that a similar approach has the potential to revitalize a struggling cannabis industry. 

On-site consumption and sale reforms offer a number of benefits to the cannabis industry and the public.  First, the reforms would provide a revenue boost to small-scale operators and cultivators.  Second, the reforms would open cannabis growing sites to the public and demystify the industry, further removing it from the shadows of the illicit drug trade.  Finally, the reforms would provide a public consumption space for consumers who otherwise lack access to legal consumption locations.

That said, reforming cannabis laws to allow for on-site consumption and sale will not come without challenges.  These include political opposition from other cannabis stakeholders, zoning, and operational challenges.  This article will address the costs and benefits of the proposed reforms, and provide a roadmap for regulatory adoption.

detail.abstract: This article examines price discrimination and dynamic pricing on AI-driven platforms through a law-and-economics framework. It explores how AI enables platforms to engage in first-degree price discrimination, systematically extracting consumer surplus. Unlike pre-AI price discrimination, which was closer to price differentiation, AI-driven dynamic pricing exhibits a stronger element of actual discrimination, allowing platforms to perpetually impose punitive pricing based on personalized data. This raises concerns about consumer welfare, as AI-driven dynamic pricing may lead to worse outcomes than traditional monopolies, with full consumer surplus extraction despite unchanged transaction volumes. In addition, this article introduces the concept of platforms in the same relevant market functioning as a de facto single entity, under the AI-driven dynamic pricing. It also explores ideas such as price discrimination akin to 'racial profiling' and the impact of platform-driven price discrimination on the erosion of the 'invisible hand.' Furthermore, the article discusses the role of government intervention, highlighting potential crowding-out effects and tax-like consequences when platforms are state-operated or subsidized. Even in purely private markets, AI-driven pricing may reduce disposable income, affecting real GDP and purchasing power. Finally, the article considers consumer protection measures, particularly the importance of obtaining consumer consent for the use of personal information in AI-driven pricing strategies.

title: Clinical and Economic Value of Robot-Assisted Surgery for Gynecologic Malignancies Under DRG Payment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Zhejiang University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Clinical and Economic Value of Robot-Assisted Surgery for Gynecologic Malignancies Under DRG Payment
detail.abstract: Abstract ObjectiveTo comprehensively evaluate the clinical and economic value of robotic surgery in gynecological malignancies and provide evidence for implementing and reimbursing assisted surgical systems.MethodsPerioperative and economic differences between robotic and laparoscopic surgeries were compared using subgroup tests. CUSUM analysis was employed to construct robotic surgery’s learning curve. A multi-dimensional comprehensive performance across two surgical approaches and 10 medical groups was ranked using TOPSIS-RSR. ITSA was used to assess the impact of reimbursement policy termination on robotic surgery volume and cost structure.ResultsRobotic surgery showed significantly less intraoperative blood loss and decreasing operative time aligned with the surgeon’s learning curve. Proficiency was achieved after 91 cases; hospital-wide maturity after 341 cases; some medical groups reached proficiency in 43 cases. TOPSIS-RSR evaluation ranked robotic surgery superior. Reimbursement policy termination had no significant effect on surgical volume or costs.ConclusionCompared to laparoscopy, robotic surgery shows superior operative efficiency and hemorrhage control after proficiency is reached. Although costlier, its comprehensive performance is superior, with laparoscopy skills transferable. The reimbursement termination had limited impact, implying economics of scale can offset costs. Future reforms should optimize reimbursement mechanisms and develop long-term cost-effectiveness frameworks to support integration under DRG systems.

title: Counting on the Sea: Quantifying the Rise of Seaborne Trade serving the United Kingdom 1820-1913
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Economics

detail.title: Counting on the Sea: Quantifying the Rise of Seaborne Trade serving the United Kingdom 1820-1913

publicationDetails.detailsText: NHH Dept. of Economics Discussion Paper No. 18/2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Norwegian School of Economics, Department of Economics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article presents a data set that provides the basis for a quantitative narrative of the work done by domestic and foreign merchant shipping serving the United Kingdom 1820-1913. Using ton-miles (weight of goods times the distance carried) as an output measure a detailed description is provided along two dimensions: countries and commodities. Annual estimates of ton-miles are provided for 479 import goods and 525 export goods in UK trade with 90 countries and provinces. Two issues have been chosen to illustrate the use of the new data: the gain from the Suez Canal and the trend growth of shipping output as an indicator of trade globalisation. There is very firm evidence that the trend rate of growth in inward shipping volumes was highest in the decades in the middle of the nineteenth century before 1870. This is in contrast to the conventional perception that the period after 1870 represents the first era of trade globalisation. For imports to the United Kingdom from all countries the gain in terms of reduced ton-miles from shortening trade routes via the Suez Canal is calculated for each year from the opening of the canal in 1870 to 1913. On the eve of World War One the Suez gain is estimated at 26 per cent for imports from Suez affected routes, from all countries there is a 10 per cent reduction in ton-miles.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了1820-1913年英国对外贸易航运的吨英里数据集，通过分析苏伊士运河开通的收益和航运增长趋势，挑战了传统认为1870年后是贸易全球化第一阶段的观点。

AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易全球化理论、航运经济学、历史计量学

title: High-Dimensional Time-varying Forecast Combination under General Loss Functions
affiliations: University of Rochester - Department of Economics and

detail.title: High-Dimensional Time-varying Forecast Combination under General Loss Functions
detail.abstract: In economics and finance, forecast combination is typically estimated using regression methods under symmetric and quadratic loss functions. However, practical forecast evaluation increasingly relies on more flexible and often asymmetric loss functions, which are particularly relevant in policy and risk management. Moreover, many existing approaches overlook potential time variation in predictive relationships. This paper proposes a unified framework for estimating time-varying forecast combination weights via nonparametric M-estimation under a broad class of loss functions, including widely used and potentially non-differentiable examples such as the lin-lin and asymmetric squared losses. We establish the asymptotic properties of the local linear estimator when the number of forecasts is fixed, and derive selection and estimation consistency for a penalized variant in high-dimensional settings. Our theoretical work advances existing convex differencing methods to the analysis of high-dimensional non-smooth M-estimators with temporal dependence, a setting where classical methods based on smoothness and first-order conditions do not apply. The techniques we develop are broadly applicable and of independent theoretical interest. An empirical application to inflation forecasting in the post-Covid period demonstrates that allowing for asymmetric loss functions and time-varying combination weights yields substantial improvements over conventional approaches based on the squared loss function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的非参数M估计框架，用于在广泛类别损失函数下估计时变预测组合权重，包括非可微损失函数。该框架在固定预测数量下建立了局部线性估计量的渐近性质，在高维设置下推导了惩罚变体的选择和估计一致性。实证应用表明，在新冠后通胀预测中，考虑非对称损失函数和时变组合权重相比传统平方损失函数方法有显著改进。
AI.research_question: 如何在非对称损失函数和时变预测关系下估计预测组合权重？
AI.motivation: 经济学和金融学中预测组合通常使用对称二次损失函数下的回归方法，但实际预测评估越来越多依赖更灵活且通常非对称的损失函数，特别是在政策和风险管理中。现有方法大多忽略预测关系中潜在的时间变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数M估计理论、局部线性估计、高维统计理论、凸差分方法
AI.method: 提出统一的非参数M估计框架，使用局部线性估计器估计时变预测组合权重，支持包括lin-lin和非对称平方损失在内的广泛类别损失函数；在高维设置下开发惩罚变体方法
AI.findings: 在固定预测数量下建立了局部线性估计量的渐近性质；在高维设置下推导了惩罚变体的选择和估计一致性；实证应用显示在新冠后通胀预测中，考虑非对称损失函数和时变组合权重相比传统方法有显著改进
AI.theory_contributions: 将现有凸差分方法推广到具有时间依赖性的高维非光滑M估计器分析中；开发的技术具有广泛适用性和独立理论价值；在基于光滑性和一阶条件的经典方法不适用的设置中提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定和风险管理提供了更灵活的预测组合方法；在新冠后通胀预测等实际应用中显示出优于传统方法的性能；支持实际应用中常见的非对称损失函数

title: The Capitalization of Energy Prices in the Housing Market
affiliations: RWI - Leibniz Institute for Economic Research

detail.title: The Capitalization of Energy Prices in the Housing Market
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the capitalization of heating costs in the housing market. To identify the causal effect of heating costs, I use the gas price increase in 2022 and the war in Ukraine as a quasi-experimental setting. In a difference-indifferences (DiD) framework, I estimate the effect of an increase in gas-based heating costs on rental prices, comparing gas-heated and renewable district heating apartments. Time on market and clicks are used as demand measures. Local gas price data at the zip code level are used to identify the local magnitude of the gas price shock and to estimate the treatment effect in a continuous DiD setting. The results reject the capitalization of heating costs in rental prices, but show that housing demand is energy price elastic. After the increase in gas prices, time on market of gas-heated apartments increases by 12.5% on average. The effect varies with the size of the local gas price shock, and an additional e100 in annual heating costs increases time on market by 0.6% on average, and by 1% at the peak in April 2022.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2022年天然气价格上涨和乌克兰战争作为准实验设置，通过双重差分法分析供暖成本对住房市场的影响。研究发现供暖成本并未资本化到租金中，但住房需求对能源价格具有弹性，天然气供暖公寓的上市时间平均增加了12.5%。

title: The Spanish Case Study: A Delphi Consensus Model for Developing a Minimum Data Set (MDS) in Middle-to-High-Income Health Systems
affiliations: Institut Català de la Salut, Institut Català de la Salut, Institut Català de la Salut and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Spanish Case Study: A Delphi Consensus Model for Developing a Minimum Data Set (MDS) in Middle-to-High-Income Health Systems
detail.abstract: BackgroundSpain's healthcare system faces critical challenges from an aging population and workforce shortages, compounded by fragmented data and the absence of a national health workforce registry. This lack of standardized, high-quality data severely impedes effective strategic planning.ObjectiveThis study aimed to establish expert consensus on the essential variables required for a Minimum Data Set (MDS) to enable accurate health workforce projection within Spain’s National Health System.MethodsA modified Delphi study was conducted (2024-2025) engaging national and regional stakeholders. Using structured questionnaires, participants rated variables on importance and feasibility via a 10-point Likert scale. Quantitative (mean scores ≥8) and qualitative analyses identified core data requirements and implementation barriers.ResultsAmong 30 invited institutions (11 national, 19 regional), 24 responded (80% participation rate). Experts reached consensus on the importance of all 15 proposed variables. However, significant feasibility gaps were identified for four critical areas: tracking new graduates, projecting demographic/epidemiological changes, assessing non-demographic factors, and measuring attrition rates. Qualitative analysis revealed 16 priority themes, including the need for modernized registries, dynamic workforce tools, educational alignment, integration of foreign specialists, and standardized public-private data.ConclusionsThis study provides the first validated MDS for Spain's health workforce planning. It exposes a critical implementation gap: while experts unanimously agree on what data is essential, systemic barriers prevent its collection. Findings mandate urgent policy action to develop interoperable data infrastructure within two years, enabling effective workforce planning and addressing Spain's healthcare challenges.

title: The Law of Military Disciplinary Sanctions
affiliations: Mississippi College - School of Law

detail.title: The Law of Military Disciplinary Sanctions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Thanks to Mississippi College School of Law for supporting this research with a research grant.

keywords: international covenant for civil and political rights

detail.abstract:
National armed forces must be disciplined, but two bodies of international law relating to military discipline seem to be in conflict. On the one hand, international humanitarian law emphasizes that militaries should employ robust disciplinary measures to deter and respond to military misconduct. On the other hand, some scholars of international human rights law have recently singled out military disciplinary measures as insufficiently protective of soldiers from unfair treatment. Proponents of this new approach recently proposed a remedy for disciplinary unfairness: military members should have the right to "turn down" disciplinary proceedings and elect to have their cases heard in military criminal trials instead. 

This article critically examines four of the underlying assumptions of this new approach. First, that international human rights law's principal concern in armed conflict should be the fair treatment of soldiers. Second, that soldiers will be treated more fairly in military criminal trials than in disciplinary proceedings. Third, that military criminal trials can easily be convened during armed conflict. And fourth, that military disciplinary measures are too harsh. I argue that the new approach of interlinking disciplinary law with penal law through a "turn down" right is a mistake, and that there is an enduring role for both disciplinary and penal actions in regulating military behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地分析了国际人权法学者提出的新方法，该方法主张军人应有权拒绝纪律程序而选择军事刑事审判。作者认为这种将纪律法与刑法通过"拒绝权"相互联系的方法存在错误，并论证了纪律和刑事行动在规范军事行为中的持久作用。

AI.theoretical_framework: 国际人道主义法与国际人权法的理论框架，军事纪律与刑事司法的关系理论

AI.findings: 新方法的四个基本假设存在问题：1）国际人权法在武装冲突中的主要关注点不应仅是士兵的公平待遇；2）军事刑事审判不一定比纪律程序更公平；3）武装冲突期间难以轻易召集军事刑事审判；4）军事纪律措施并非过于严厉
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了国际人道主义法与国际人权法在军事纪律问题上的关系，论证了纪律程序与刑事审判各自的作用边界

title: Radical Safeguarding: A Social Justice Workbook for Safeguarding Practitioners
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: Radical Safeguarding: A Social Justice Workbook for Safeguarding Practitioners

declarations.funderStatement: This workbook was commissioned by Maslaha

detail.abstract:
Radical Safeguarding - A Social Justice Workbook for Safeguarding Practitioners is designed for practitioners working with children and young people, particularly in school contexts, who might be wondering how to start doing things differently when it comes to safeguarding. 

We created this resource because we know that ‘safeguarding’ often actively causes harm to the most marginalised young people, particularly young people of colour, and that ‘safeguarding’ training and structures often leave practitioners feeling fearful, lacking in agency and resigned to responding in ways that they know will cause young people and their families further harm. The resource problematises current safeguarding strategies and practices that pathologise, criminalise and harm children, particularly those from oppressed communities.

Our understanding of a radical approach to child safety is one that traces the root cause of harms to children. This resource looks at some of the cultures and structures that underpin and enable this harm and suggests some models for understanding child safety and a range of practical approaches and activities that we hope can support practitioners in fostering alternative, resistant, safeguarding practices.

title: Bhagavad Gita as a Pillar of Hindu Philosophy: A Bibliometric Analysis of Using OpenAlex (1846-2025)
affiliations: Lingaya's Vidyapeeth(A Deemed-to-be-University)

detail.title: Bhagavad Gita as a Pillar of Hindu Philosophy: A Bibliometric Analysis of Using OpenAlex (1846-2025)
detail.abstract: This bibliometric study examines 1,150 scholarly documents published between 1846 and 2025 concerning the Bhagavad Gita. Spanning 593 publication sources and involving 1,445 authors, the dataset reveals a predominantly individualistic authorship trend, with 810 single-authored works and minimal international collaboration (4.35%). The average number of citations per document stands at 2.95, while the average age of the publications is 13.4 years. Despite its historical depth, the field shows a modest annual growth rate of 2.31%. Publication output remained negligible until the 1990s but surged significantly after 2005, peaking at over 90 articles in a single year before 2025. Citation analysis identifies both historically impactful and recently influential works, with normalized citation scores highlighting contemporary relevance. The authorship pattern aligns with Lotka's Law, indicating that most authors contribute only once. The data reflects a maturing research area with increasing scholarly engagement, diverse disciplinary involvement, and evolving publication platforms, reinforcing the Bhagavad Gita's enduring academic and cultural significance.

title: Liquidity Creation and Bank Failure

detail.title: Liquidity Creation and Bank Failure

declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between banks’ liquidity creation and their likelihood of failure. Using data on U.S. banks from 1984 to 2016, we find evidence of a non-linear relationship:  both excessively high and abnormally low liquidity creation are associated with an increased probability of failure. The finding remains robust across multiple checks, including random sampling, placebo tests, and alternative failure definitions.

title: When Complexity Excuses Enforcement: The Regulatory Gap in Tax-Exempt Money Market Fund Disclosure of Municipal VRDO Deemed Reissuances
affiliations: Tongji University

detail.title: When Complexity Excuses Enforcement: The Regulatory Gap in Tax-Exempt Money Market Fund Disclosure of Municipal VRDO Deemed Reissuances

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
This Article exposes the most egregious enforcement asymmetry in modern securities regulation: while state attorneys general and federal prosecutors pursue remarketing agents for systematic Variable Rate Demand Obligation (VRDO) manipulation through record settlements and ongoing litigation, money market fund managers whose shareholders directly profited from these violations have entirely escaped regulatory accountability. Despite collecting billions in management fees on artificially enhanced returns generated by systematic violations, fund managers have systematically concealed obvious deemed reissuance risks from investors while regulatory authorities pursue zero enforcement actions.

Justice Andrew Borrok's April 2025 decision in State of New York ex rel. Edelweiss Fund LLC v. JPMorgan Chase & Co. eliminates all remaining excuses for this enforcement failure. The court found substantial evidence that remarketing agents' systematic "bucketing" practices operated outside disclosed parameters—establishing the prerequisite condition that, when combined with interest rate changes of 25 basis points or more under Treas. Reg. § 1.1001-3, would trigger deemed reissuances affecting the tax-exempt status of fund distributions. This judicial validation, combined with current market volatility creating mathematical certainty of ongoing Treasury Regulation threshold breaches, makes continued regulatory inaction toward money market fund managers a dereliction of investor protection duties.

The Article establishes that regulatory authorities can no longer justify enforcement asymmetry that protects primary beneficiaries while pursuing only those who implemented violations. The evidence is overwhelming, the judicial validation of undisclosed practices is explicit, and current violations are mathematically demonstrable when these practices combine with documented rate movements. The time for regulatory complexity excuses has ended.
