title: A Study of Algorithmic Collusion in Multi-dealer-to-client Platforms
affiliations: University of Oxford and

detail.title: A Study of Algorithmic Collusion in Multi-dealer-to-client Platforms

declarations.funderStatement: This research has been supported by the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Mathematics of Random Systems: Analysis, Modelling and Simulation (EP/S023925/1)

detail.abstract: We propose a game-theoretic model for a multi-dealer-to-client (MD2C) platform in financial markets in which multiple market makers compete for market share and learn from market data to adjust their spreads. We show the existence of a Competitive Nash Equilibrium under mild assumptions, and propose a well-defined notion of collusion. We model the learning process through a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm and show that, even in the absence of price information sharing, under the mechanism of MD2C platforms, market prices may converge to levels which are similar to a collusion situation, resulting in 'tacit collusion'. We show that the 'tacit collusion' phenomenon is robust under different market configurations, characterized by a reward-punishment scheme. We then discuss the implications of our research for market regulators, on optimal execution rules and market transparency.

title: Higher Education Expansion and the Rise of the Skill-Intensive Sector
affiliations: Charles River Associates (CRA)

detail.title: Higher Education Expansion and the Rise of the Skill-Intensive Sector
detail.abstract: Vietnam established over 100 new universities during 2006-2013, drastically improving access to higher education across the country. We examine the extent that this policy affects the sectoral reallocation of workers and firms and the general equilibrium implications for the labor market. Combining the timing of university opening with the unexpected end of the expansion, we find that exposure to the expansion induces labor reallocation from low-skilled to high-skilled industries. Hourly wages increase substantially, driven mainly by female workers and workers at the bottom of the wage distribution. We document significant increases in the number of firms in the skill-intensive industries, especially in specialized services such as IT, finance, and healthcare. Firm entry raises average firm-level total factor productivity but lowers average capital intensity. The expansion of university and the rise of the skill-intensive industries raise overall employment, but have a negative employment effect on older college-educated workers, as the labor reallocation effect is driven almost entirely by younger cohorts. The structural transformation channel increases the college wage premium by 17.1% while the imperfect substitution across skill levels decreases the premium by 6.7%.

AI.tldr: 越南在2006-2013年间建立了100多所新大学，大幅提高了高等教育机会。研究发现这一政策促进了劳动力从低技能行业向高技能行业的重新配置，提高了小时工资，特别是女性和低收入群体。技能密集型行业企业数量显著增加，但降低了平均资本密集度。大学扩张对年轻群体就业有积极影响，但对年长大学毕业生有负面就业效应。

title: Antitrust Enforcers of the World, Unite! – Time to Rethink Article 101 TFEU and Labor Market Restrictions
affiliations: University of Copenhagen - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Antitrust Enforcers of the World, Unite! – Time to Rethink Article 101 TFEU and Labor Market Restrictions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Recent developments suggest that antitrust authorities have increasingly converged on using competition law as a tool to improve the working conditions of European citizens. This orientation is reflected in the emergence of concepts such as “wage cartels” and in enforcement measures targeting non-poaching agreements. Paradoxically, however, this coincides with intensified scrutiny of self-employed gig workers who, despite seeking improved labor protections, remain constrained by the prohibitions of Article 101 TFEU. From a broader perspective, neither approach appears satisfactory. In a labor market where fewer than one-quarter of European workers are unionized, collective bargaining - the traditional mechanism for safeguarding labor standards and explicitly permitted under Article 101 TFEU – is losing relevance. This situation highlights the need to reassess the role of competition law in the labor market. A promising path forward may lie in embracing the approach proposed by the Advocate General in CD. Tondela, which would involve reinterpreting the notion of “by-object” restrictions.

title: Methods for the Economic Evaluation of Health Impacts of Climate Action. A Scoping Review
affiliations: London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, Office of Health Economics, , Office of Health Economics, City University London, London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, Euro-Mediterranean Center on Climate Change (CMCC), London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine - Library & Archives Service, London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine

detail.title: Methods for the Economic Evaluation of Health Impacts of Climate Action. A Scoping Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Paul Oyalo, Patricia Cubi-Molla, Hannah Hussain, and Mireia Jofre-Bonet are employees of the Office of Health Economics (OHE), a registered charity, and an Independent Research Organisation, which receives funding from a variety of private and public sector sources.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding for the development of this guidance was provided by the Wellcome Trust [UK - 641753963.1] C-011237. The views expressed in this paper reflect those of the authors and not necessarily those of the funder.

detail.abstract:
Background and Motivation: Climate action holds the promise of delivering significant health benefits, including increased life expectancy, improved quality of life, and enhanced global well-being. Despite this potential, there is no standardised best practice guidelines to quantify these health impacts and assess the cost-effectiveness of climate action interventions through economic evaluation frameworks. This review seeks to address this gap by first identifying and analysing frameworks from health economics and environmental economics that assess the economic value of health co-benefits from climate actions, through both mitigation and adaptation, as a necessary first step in the development of guidance in this area. This aligns with the ECO-CHICA project objectives to guide policymakers and researchers toward adopting consistent and evidence-based methods to prioritize interventions that yield environmental and health co-benefits.
Methods: A systematic scoping review of peer-reviewed literature was conducted to explore the research landscape on the economic evaluation of health impacts arising from climate action. Policy reports and grey literature were also reviewed to ensure comprehensive coverage. Methodological frameworks from health and environmental economics were compared to evaluate their respective strengths, limitations, and gaps in capturing the health co-benefits in climate action assessments.
Results and Expected Contribution: Preliminary findings suggest that health economics provides detailed, robust, and consistent methodologies for quantifying health outcomes, but these methods are often underutilised in climate actions evaluations. Conversely, environmental economics offers a broader assessment of climate impacts but frequently lacks standardised and rigorous health metrics aligned with health economics frameworks. Therefore, this review synthesises existing economic evaluation methods by assessing their adequacy, consistency, and robustness, to identify areas of potential standardisation and best guidelines for best practice when conducting economic evaluations of health impacts of climate action in different contexts. The review also identified opportunities to improve existing practices to support future policy development around climate action where there are health co-benefits.
Conclusion: This study lays the groundwork for advancing economic evaluations of the health impacts from climate action. By integrating approaches from health and environmental economics, the findings aim to inform policymakers and researchers in designing evidence-based, systematic, and coherent climate policies, reflecting both economic and health benefits.

AI.tldr: 该综述研究分析了评估气候行动健康协同效益经济价值的方法框架，发现健康经济学方法在气候行动评估中未充分利用，而环境经济学缺乏标准化健康指标。研究旨在为制定气候行动健康影响经济评估的最佳实践指南提供基础。
AI.research_question: 如何评估气候行动产生的健康协同效益的经济价值？现有健康经济学和环境经济学框架在评估这些效益时存在哪些优势和局限？
AI.motivation: 尽管气候行动能带来显著健康效益，但目前缺乏标准化最佳实践指南来量化这些健康影响，并通过经济评估框架评估气候行动干预措施的成本效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康经济学和环境经济学的经济评估框架，包括成本效益分析、健康结果量化方法和环境影响评估方法。
AI.method: 系统性范围综述，包括同行评审文献的系统审查，以及政策报告和灰色文献的补充分析，比较健康经济学和环境经济学的方法框架。
AI.findings: 健康经济学提供详细、稳健和一致的健康结果量化方法，但在气候行动评估中未充分利用；环境经济学提供更广泛的气候影响评估，但缺乏与健康经济学框架一致的标准化健康指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合健康经济学和环境经济学方法，为气候行动健康影响的经济评估提供理论框架，识别标准化机会和最佳实践指南。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供证据基础，支持设计系统、连贯的气候政策，反映经济和健康效益，指导优先选择产生环境和健康协同效益的干预措施。

title: Building Resilient Ocean Communities: Early Warning Systems and Knowledge Management for Pacific Islands Countries
affiliations: Jahangirnagar University

detail.title: Building Resilient Ocean Communities: Early Warning Systems and Knowledge Management for Pacific Islands Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships with any other people or organizations that may have, or could be perceived to have, influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethical approval or informed consent as it involved no human subjects, in accordance with institutional guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding: None. This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Pacific Islands Countries face unparalleled ocean-related challenges, from escalating sea level rise speeding up to more intense and frequent extreme weather conditions, threatening the livelihoods of over 12.7 million people across 22 countries and territories on 30 million square kilometres of ocean (World Bank, 2024; Pacific Islands Forum Secretariat, 2023). This close reading takes into account the critical need for comprehensive early warning systems, smart information gateways, and robust knowledge management databases in enhancing the disaster preparedness and response capability in the region. Through detailed analysis of the current gaps, international best practices, and emerging technologies, we recommend a overall framework based on four key pillars: complete risk awareness and understanding, advanced detection and forecasting systems, effective warning dissemination infrastructure, and community-based preparedness capabilities. The research recognizes intimidating data integration and systems coordination gaps, where over 65% of Pacific Island nations lack one integrated multi-hazard early warning system (Pacific Disaster Center, 2024). Our quantitative data confirms climate disasters drain the economies of Pacific Islands by an average of 2.3% of GDP annually, with some nations experiencing losses of over 8% during major events (Asian Development Bank, 2024; UNDRR, 2023). The findings of the report underscore that effective early warning systems require significant policy transformation, sustained financial commitments, and real cooperation between national policymakers and international development stakeholders. This paper recommends actionable, evidence-based solutions centered on community-based approaches, climate-resilient digital infrastructure planning, and holistic capacity building interventions. The approach detailed here is a complete roadmap for building resilient ocean communities that can respond effectively to impending climate vulnerabilities without sacrificing cultural values and traditional knowledge systems. The cost-benefit analysis suggests 6:1 to 12:1 return opportunities for investments in early warning systems, putting such programs at the head of the list of economically sensible adaptation opportunities open to Pacific Island governments.

title: Nudging a Healthier Nation: A Behavioural Economics Framework for India's GST 2.0
affiliations: Central University of Jammu

detail.title: Nudging a Healthier Nation: A Behavioural Economics Framework for India's GST 2.0
detail.abstract: India stands at a critical juncture, facing a rising epidemic of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) linked to dietary habits. The current Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime, while a landmark fiscal reform, exhibits significant behavioural inconsistencies in its taxation of unhealthy food products, creating a confusing and ineffective public health signal. This paper argues for a "GST 2.0" reform, moving away from a blunt, category-based "sin tax" towards a sophisticated, nutrient-based model grounded in the principles of Behavioural Economics. By analyzing the shortcomings of the current system and drawing on international precedents, we propose a 4-tier, nutrient-based GST structure. This model acts as a powerful form of Choice Architecture, designed to nudge both consumers towards healthier choices and manufacturers towards product reformulation. The research synthesizes behavioural principles like Salience, Mental Accounting, and Default Options to create a robust framework. The proposed hypotheses suggest that such a system will be more effective in altering consumption patterns and encouraging industry change than the status quo. The discussion concludes that a behaviourally-informed GST 2.0 is not merely a public health intervention but a rational fiscal policy that offers a win-win for national health and economic well-being.

title: Tax Revolutions: Dollars, Rights, and Social Change
affiliations: University of Akron - The George W. Daverio School of Accountancy

detail.title: Tax Revolutions: Dollars, Rights, and Social Change
detail.abstract: This Article explores the intersection of tax policy and civil rights in the United States, examining how fiscal measures have historically influenced and been influenced by social justice movements. Through an analysis of key historical periods, including the abolitionist movement, the Jim Crow era, and the Civil Rights Movement of the 1950s and 1960s, this Article reveals the dual role of tax policy as both a tool for advancing and obstructing social equity. The discussion extends to contemporary tax policies, such as the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 and proposals for wealth taxes, highlighting their implications for income inequality and social justice. By tracing the evolution of tax laws and their impact on civil rights, this Article provides a comprehensive understanding of the role of tax policy in the ongoing struggle for social equity. It contends that tax policy should be aligned with the principles of justice and equality to promote a more equitable society.

AI.motivation: 理解税收政策在民权斗争中的双重角色，以及如何将税收政策与正义平等原则相结合以促进更公平的社会。

AI.method: 历史时期分析，包括废奴运动、吉姆·克劳时代和民权运动的关键历史阶段分析。
AI.findings: 税收政策在历史上既被用作促进社会公平的工具，也被用于阻碍社会公平；当代税收政策如2017年减税与就业法案和财富税提案对收入不平等和社会正义有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了税收政策在民权斗争中作用的全面理解，建立了税收政策与社会正义之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了将税收政策与正义平等原则相结合的实践指导，促进更公平社会的建设。

title: World Interest Rate and Emerging Market Spread: A Tale of Two Shocks
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, The University of Hong Kong and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: World Interest Rate and Emerging Market Spread: A Tale of Two Shocks
detail.abstract: Global interest rates are often viewed as a key determinant of emerging market (EM) borrowing costs, yet their empirical correlation with credit spreads is weak. We show that the source of world interest rate movements is crucial. Using a structural VAR, we distinguish between two types of U.S. shocks that drive the world interest rate: procyclical shocks, which raise U.S. output and interest rates jointly, and countercyclical shocks, which move them in opposite directions. While both raise the world interest rate, they have opposite effects on EM spreads: procyclical shocks lower spreads, whereas countercyclical shocks raise them substantially. To interpret these findings, we develop a quantitative sovereign default model with long-term debt, risk-averse lenders, inconvenience yield, and both shocks. The model replicates the differential response of spreads to procyclical and countercyclical shocks. We decompose such responses into a default risk, a risk premium, and an inconvenience yield component. Countercyclical shocks raise spreads primarily through higher default probabilities linked to lower EM output, while procyclical shocks reduce spreads despite higher financing costs because they are associated with higher EM output.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，世界利率变动对新兴市场信用利差的影响取决于利率变动的来源。将美国冲击分为顺周期（同时提高产出和利率）和逆周期（产出与利率反向变动）两类，前者降低新兴市场利差，后者大幅提高利差。通过构建主权违约模型，揭示了不同冲击通过违约风险、风险溢价和不便收益等渠道对利差的差异化影响机制。
AI.research_question: 世界利率变动如何影响新兴市场信用利差？不同类型的利率冲击对新兴市场利差有何差异化影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然全球利率常被视为新兴市场借贷成本的关键决定因素，但其与信用利差的实证相关性较弱，表明需要更深入地理解利率变动的来源和传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构VAR模型、定量主权违约模型（含长期债务、风险厌恶贷款人、不便收益等要素）
AI.method: 使用结构VAR识别美国顺周期和逆周期冲击，构建包含长期债务、风险厌恶贷款人、不便收益的主权违约模型进行定量分析
AI.findings: 顺周期冲击（同时提高美国产出和利率）降低新兴市场利差，逆周期冲击（美国产出与利率反向变动）大幅提高新兴市场利差；逆周期冲击主要通过提高违约概率增加利差，而顺周期冲击尽管融资成本上升，但因新兴市场产出增加而降低利差
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了不同类型利率冲击对新兴市场利差的差异化影响机制，完善了国际金融传导理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场政策制定者提供了更精准的风险管理框架，帮助识别和应对不同类型全球利率冲击的影响

title: Regulating Credit Markets with Time-Inconsistent Consumers
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi, University of Southern California, Columbia University and Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Regulating Credit Markets with Time-Inconsistent Consumers
detail.abstract: We characterize equilibrium contracts for naïve present-biased consumers under regulatory constraints (such as caps on leverages or fees). We show that the asymptotic welfare loss from present bias depends on the firm's ability to promise back-loaded consumption that consumers believe they will pick, in exchange for front-loaded consumption that they actually pick. When firms are able to offer sufficiently backloaded consumption, the welfare loss from time inconsistency vanishes as the horizon grows. When contracting constraints prevent them from further back-loading consumption-the consumer's "imaginary" future consumption has been maxed out-the welfare loss persists no matter how long the contracting horizon is. We show that reducing the maximum fees firms are allowed to charge may lower welfare. We also consider welfare distortions in different contractual environments, such as with one-sided commitment and with market power.

AI.tldr: 本文分析在监管约束下对现时偏误消费者的均衡合约设计，发现福利损失取决于企业能否提供后置消费承诺。当企业能充分后置消费时，时间不一致性导致的福利损失随期限增长而消失；当合约约束阻止进一步后置消费时，福利损失持续存在。降低最高收费可能损害福利。
AI.research_question: 在监管约束下，现时偏误消费者的均衡合约设计如何影响福利损失？
AI.motivation: 理解监管政策（如杠杆率上限、费用上限）如何影响对行为偏误消费者的合约设计及其福利后果
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的现时偏误理论、合约理论、监管经济学
AI.method: 理论建模分析均衡合约设计，考察不同监管约束下的福利影响
AI.findings: 福利损失取决于企业后置消费的能力；充分后置消费可消除福利损失；收费上限可能降低福利；不同合约环境（单边承诺、市场势力）产生不同福利扭曲
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了现时偏误消费者在监管约束下的合约理论框架，揭示了后置消费机制在缓解时间不一致性问题中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管政策设计提供理论指导，指出单纯限制收费可能适得其反，应关注合约结构设计

title: Technological Links and Predictable Factors

detail.title: Technological Links and Predictable Factors
detail.abstract: I examine whether technological links between firms — measured by patent-based similarity — can forecast not only firm-level returns but also systematic risk factors. Building on Lee et al. (2019), I extend the analysis to test the Arbitrage Pricing Theory (APT), which predicts that return predictability exists if and only if risk factors are themselves predictable. Using the Fama–French five-factor and Carhart momentum factor from 1980 to 2020, I show that technology-linked returns predict factor returns, particularly value, profitability, and momentum factors. The predictive power is strongest at a one-month horizon, consistent with sluggish price adjustment, and remains robust under orthogonalization tests. These findings highlight the role of technological spillovers in shaping asset prices, provide new empirical evidence for APT, and contribute to the literature on cross-firm information transmission and factor predictability.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业间技术关联（基于专利相似性）是否能预测企业层面回报和系统性风险因子。研究发现技术关联回报能预测价值、盈利能力和动量因子回报，支持套利定价理论。
AI.research_question: 技术关联是否能预测企业层面回报和系统性风险因子？技术关联回报的预测能力是否支持套利定价理论？
AI.motivation: 基于Lee等人(2019)的研究，将分析扩展到测试套利定价理论，该理论预测只有当风险因子本身可预测时，回报可预测性才存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 套利定价理论(APT)、技术溢出理论、价格调整滞后理论
AI.method: 使用Fama-French五因子和Carhart动量因子，时间跨度为1980-2020年，进行正交化检验
AI.findings: 技术关联回报能预测因子回报，特别是价值、盈利能力和动量因子；预测能力在一个月时间跨度最强，与价格调整滞后一致；结果在正交化检验中保持稳健
AI.theory_contributions: 为套利定价理论提供新的实证证据，强调技术溢出在资产定价中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 对跨企业信息传递和因子可预测性文献做出贡献，为投资者提供基于技术关联的因子预测工具

reference: The Asian Yearbook of Human Rights and Humanitarian Law, Volume 3,
title: An Appraisal of the Constitutional Development and its Impact on the Political Economy of Pakistan

detail.title: An Appraisal of the Constitutional Development and its Impact on the Political Economy of Pakistan

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Asian Yearbook of Human Rights and Humanitarian Law, Volume 3,

detail.abstract: Pakistan had a turbulent history of Constitutional and political development which not only destabilized democracy but circumvented the economic development as a result of weak constitutional structures. The three martial-law regimes (i.e. Ayub, Zia and Musharraf) not only elected themselves as presidents of Pakistan through so-called polls but also managed to form weak Parliaments in order to take control over it by introducing random amendments in the Constitution of Pakistan which messed up the process of development. The key objective of this article is to examine the impacts depicted on the constitutional, political, economic aspects and the rule of law situation in Pakistan as a result of some judicial decisions by the apex Court.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了巴基斯坦最高法院的司法判决对宪法、政治、经济和法治状况的影响，重点关注三个军事政权时期（阿尤布、齐亚、穆沙拉夫）通过宪法修正案破坏民主和经济发展的问题。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦最高法院的司法判决对宪法、政治、经济和法治状况产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦宪法和政治发展的动荡历史不仅破坏了民主，还因宪法结构薄弱而阻碍了经济发展。三个军事政权通过所谓的选举自任总统，并通过宪法修正案组建弱势议会来控制权力，扰乱了发展进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法发展理论、司法政治理论、军事政权对民主制度的影响理论
AI.method: 历史分析法和案例分析法，分析三个军事政权时期的宪法修正案和最高法院相关判决
AI.findings: 军事政权通过宪法修正案破坏了宪法结构，削弱了议会权力，导致民主制度受损，经济发展受阻，法治状况恶化
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对军事政权如何通过宪法修正和司法判决影响民主制度和经济发展的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦宪法改革和司法独立提供实践启示，有助于防止类似问题重演

title: Health economic impact and cost threshold for switching from bivalent to nonavalent HPV vaccination for preadolescent girls in KwaZulu Natal, South Africa: A mathematical modeling analysis accounting for the HIV epidemic
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Washington, Stellenbosch University, Columbia University - Irving Medical Center, Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, Harvard University - Massachusetts General Hospital and University of Washington

detail.title: Health economic impact and cost threshold for switching from bivalent to nonavalent HPV vaccination for preadolescent girls in KwaZulu Natal, South Africa: A mathematical modeling analysis accounting for the HIV epidemic
detail.abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus bivalent (2vHPV) and nonavalent (9vHPV) vaccines demonstrate effectiveness against HPV types causing 70% and 90% of cervical cancers, respectively. Current South African guidelines recommend vaccinating girls ages 9-14 with one dose of 2vHPV. Switching recommendations to 9vHPV has the potential to avert more cervical cancer burden, but the cost-effectiveness and cost-threshold at which 9vHPV would provide good value for money in South Africa is unknown.Methods: Using a validated compartmental HPV and HIV transmission model parameterized to KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, we simulated scenarios of 2vHPV and 9vHPV implementation over 100 years with two doses (72% coverage) and one dose (80% and 90% coverage) and evaluated scenarios assuming lifelong or waning single-dose vaccine efficacy. We estimated cervical cancer cases and deaths averted for single-dose vaccination with 9vHPV vs. 2vHPV at 80% coverage. We estimated the health impacts and maximum cost/dose at which 9vHPV would be cost-effective using willingness-to-pay thresholds ranging from $500/DALY averted to $3,015/DALY averted (2023 USD). We also assessed the health impacts and incremental cost-effectiveness ratios (ICERs) of 9vHPV at current costs ($110/dose) compared to 2vHPV ($9.23/dose).Results:  Single-dose 9vHPV at 80% coverage could avert 7.9% more cervical cancer cases and 6.4% more deaths than 2vHPV (lifelong efficacy scenario). The maximum per-dose cost for 9vHPV to be cost-effective (lifelong efficacy and 80% coverage) ranged from $15 ($500/DALY averted threshold) to $45/dose ($3,015/DALY averted threshold). Assuming waning single-dose efficacy, maximum 9vHPV per dose costs ranged from $15 to $50/dose, depending on the threshold. At current market costs, single-dose 9vHPV at 90% coverage exceeds commonly used cost-effective thresholds with ICERs of $10,480/DALY averted (lifelong efficacy) and $8,806/DALY averted (waning efficacy).Conclusions: Implementing 9vHPV can result in greater reduction of cervical cancer burden than 2vHPV, but vaccine cost needs to be reduced for 9vHPV to be cost-effective in KwaZulu-Natal.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了在南非从二价HPV疫苗转向九价HPV疫苗的成本效益。研究发现九价疫苗能预防更多宫颈癌，但当前价格下不具备成本效益，需要将价格降至15-50美元/剂才能实现成本效益。
AI.research_question: 在南非从二价HPV疫苗转向九价HPV疫苗的成本效益和成本阈值是多少？
AI.motivation: 九价HPV疫苗能预防90%的宫颈癌，比二价疫苗（预防70%）更有效，但九价疫苗成本更高，需要评估其在南非的成本效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用经过验证的HPV和HIV传播模型，基于南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省的数据参数化。
AI.method: 模拟100年内二价和九价HPV疫苗接种情景，包括两剂（72%覆盖率）和单剂（80%和90%覆盖率）方案，评估终身或衰减的单剂疫苗效力。
AI.findings: 单剂九价疫苗在80%覆盖率下比二价疫苗多预防7.9%的宫颈癌病例和6.4%的死亡；九价疫苗需要将价格降至15-50美元/剂才能实现成本效益；当前价格下不具备成本效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为资源有限国家从低效疫苗转向高效疫苗的成本效益评估提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南非和其他类似国家的HPV疫苗接种政策制定提供了具体的经济证据，建议通过价格谈判使九价疫苗更具可及性。

title: When Nudges Backfire: How Not To Improve Attitudes Towards Shared E-Scooters
affiliations: University of Warwick and University of Warwick

detail.title: When Nudges Backfire: How Not To Improve Attitudes Towards Shared E-Scooters
detail.abstract: As part of a push towards sustainable transportation, there have been several rental e-scooter trials in UK cities. However, vandalism and mistreatment have plagued these schemes, and the adoption of e-scooters remains low. We test the effectiveness of nudges designed to improve attitudes and uptake of shared e-scooters. These nudges are based on three main mechanisms: ownership, social norm messaging, and social status signalling. We find that our main ownership and social status nudges are not only ineffective, they worsen attitudes towards shared e-scooters and reduce intended uptake. Injunctive norm messaging did not have any significant impact on stated adoption or willingness to report misuse. Our results highlight the potential consequences of nudges that backfire. We recommend carefully testing proposed nudges within the intended context before implementation, even if they have been successful in a different context, in order to avoid negative consequences.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了三种助推机制（所有权、社会规范信息和社会地位信号）对共享电动滑板车态度和采用意愿的影响。研究发现，所有权和社会地位助推不仅无效，反而恶化了人们对共享电动滑板车的态度并减少了采用意愿。禁令性规范信息对采用意愿或报告滥用行为的意愿没有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 助推机制（所有权、社会规范信息和社会地位信号）是否能有效改善人们对共享电动滑板车的态度并提高采用意愿？
AI.motivation: 英国城市进行了多项共享电动滑板车试验，但破坏行为和不当使用问题严重，且采用率仍然很低，需要找到有效方法改善这一状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学的助推理论，特别是所有权效应、社会规范理论和社会地位信号理论。
AI.method: 实验研究，测试三种不同类型的助推机制对共享电动滑板车态度和采用意愿的影响。
AI.findings: 主要的所有权和社会地位助推不仅无效，反而恶化了人们对共享电动滑板车的态度并减少了采用意愿。禁令性规范信息没有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了助推可能产生反效果的风险，强调了在特定情境下测试助推有效性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议在实施助推前，即使在其他情境中已证明有效，也应在目标情境中进行仔细测试，以避免负面后果。

title: Tax Avoidance and ESG Disclosure Mandate: International Evidence
affiliations: University of Alberta - Campus Saint-Jean, University of South Carolina - Moore School of Business, Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business and University of Texas at El Paso

detail.title: Tax Avoidance and ESG Disclosure Mandate: International Evidence
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how regulations mandating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) disclosure affect an important dimension of a firm’s financial decision, namely its tax payments. Using a difference-in-differences analysis on a sample of firms from 48 countries, we find that ESG disclosure mandates lead to significant reductions in tax 
avoidance, with stronger effects for mandates that include tax-relevant components. We identify increases in ESG information transparency and improvements in firms’ ESG 
performance as channels through which ESG disclosure mandates reduce tax avoidance. We further find that the decrease in tax avoidance following ESG disclosure mandates is more pronounced in countries with weaker financial disclosure requirements, weaker legal and tax enforcement, and weaker environmental and social institutions. Collectively, the evidence suggests that non-financial disclosure regulations can curb aggressive tax behavior, supporting broader goals of corporate accountability and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: ESG披露法规通过提高信息透明度和改善ESG表现，显著减少了企业避税行为，特别是在金融披露要求较弱、法律和税收执法较弱的国家效果更明显。
AI.research_question: ESG披露法规如何影响企业的税收支付决策？
AI.motivation: 研究非财务披露法规是否能够约束企业的激进避税行为，支持企业问责制和可持续发展的更广泛目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露理论、企业社会责任理论和税收遵从理论，探讨ESG披露对企业行为的约束机制。
AI.method: 采用双重差分分析法，对来自48个国家的企业样本进行研究。
AI.findings: ESG披露法规显著减少了企业避税行为，特别是包含税收相关内容的法规效果更强；ESG信息透明度提高和ESG表现改善是主要传导机制；在金融披露要求较弱、法律和税收执法较弱的国家效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了非财务披露对企业财务决策影响的理论框架，揭示了ESG披露通过信息透明度和绩效改善约束避税行为的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了ESG披露法规能够有效约束企业避税行为的实证证据，支持企业问责制和可持续发展目标的实现。

title: Work From Home and the Post-COVID Spending Surge
affiliations: University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Work From Home and the Post-COVID Spending Surge
detail.abstract: U.S. personal saving rates have remained below pre-pandemic levels. This paper links the sustained increase in consumption to the rise of working from home (WFH). Using PSID 2019-2023 data and an industry-based instrument for WFH, I find that households induced to WFH raised expenditure by more than $7,000 on average, holding income and wealth constant. Spending rose not only among movers but also among non-movers, consistent with a persistent shift in preferences toward housing-complementary consumption. The estimates imply that WFH reduced the aggregate saving rate by 1.2 percentage points, and they suggest that remote work structurally increased demand for housing-related consumption, contributing to the post-pandemic spending boom.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现远程工作(WFH)导致美国家庭平均增加超过7000美元支出，使总储蓄率下降1.2个百分点，推动了疫情后消费繁荣。
AI.research_question: 远程工作如何影响美国家庭的消费行为和储蓄率？
AI.motivation: 美国个人储蓄率持续低于疫情前水平，需要解释消费持续增长的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房互补消费理论、偏好转变理论
AI.method: 使用PSID 2019-2023数据，采用基于行业的工具变量法分析远程工作对消费的影响
AI.findings: 远程工作家庭平均增加超过7000美元支出；不仅搬家者支出增加，非搬家者也增加；远程工作使总储蓄率下降1.2个百分点
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了远程工作通过改变偏好促进住房互补消费的结构性影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了疫情后消费繁荣的原因，为理解储蓄率变化提供新视角

title: Intelligent Waste Collection Optimization Using AI And IoT in urban Environments
affiliations: University of Toronto - Department of Civil Engineering, McGill University - School of Computer Science, University of Toronto - Department of Civil Engineering, McGill University - School of Computer Science and University of Toronto - Department of Civil Engineering

detail.title: Intelligent Waste Collection Optimization Using AI And IoT in urban Environments
detail.abstract: Efficient waste collection remains a critical challenge in rapidly urbanizing cities, where conventional fixed-route systems often result in redundant trips and overflow incidents. This study proposes an integrated framework that combines IoT-based fill-level sensing, short-term prediction using long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, and route optimization through a capacity-constrained traveling salesman problem (TSP) model solved by genetic algorithms. A three-month pilot was conducted across 150 collection points in a high-density district, with two experimental groups using the AI-IoT framework and one control group operating under conventional schedules. The results demonstrated that the experimental districts achieved a 24.8% reduction in redundant collection trips and a 30.2% decrease in overflow incidents, both statistically significant at p < 0.05. Furthermore, the LSTM prediction module reached a coefficient of determination of R² = 0.92 with a mean absolute error of 0.07, outperforming baseline regression methods. These findings confirm that integrating predictive analytics and IoT-enabled monitoring within a closed feedback loop can deliver measurable environmental and operational benefits. The framework not only enhances immediate efficiency but also provides a scalable model for sustainable urban waste management.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出结合物联网填充水平传感、LSTM短期预测和遗传算法路径优化的集成框架，在150个收集点进行三个月试点，结果显示实验组减少了24.8%的冗余收集行程和30.2%的溢出事件，LSTM预测R²达到0.92。
AI.research_question: 如何通过AI-IoT集成框架提高城市垃圾收集效率？
AI.motivation: 快速城市化中传统固定路线系统导致冗余行程和溢出事件，需要更高效的垃圾收集解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物联网传感技术、长短期记忆网络(LSTM)预测模型、容量约束旅行商问题(TSP)理论、遗传算法优化。
AI.method: 在150个收集点进行三个月试点研究，设置两个实验组(使用AI-IoT框架)和一个对照组(传统调度)，比较收集效率和溢出率。
AI.findings: 实验组实现24.8%冗余收集行程减少和30.2%溢出事件减少(p<0.05)，LSTM预测R²=0.92，MAE=0.07，优于基准回归方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将预测分析与物联网监控集成在闭环反馈系统中的理论框架，为可持续城市废物管理提供可扩展模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可量化的环境和运营效益，包括减少冗余行程和溢出事件，提高垃圾收集效率，为可持续城市废物管理提供实用解决方案。

title: Preferences for Individual Metering and Billing
affiliations: University of Zurich - Department of Economics and University of Zurich

detail.title: Preferences for Individual Metering and Billing

declarations.ethicsApproval: The survey experiment reported in this paper was approved by the Human Subjects Committee of the Faculty of Economics, Business Administration and Information Technology at the University of Zurich (reference: 2024-078).
declarations.funderStatement: The research was supported by the Swiss National Science Foundation (Project 201958).

detail.abstract: Millions of households around the world must share utility bills with their neighbors due to a lack of household-specific meters. Individual metering and billing has been shown to strongly reduce consumption of heat, electricity, and water, but households' willingness to pay the costs of metering is unknown. This study uses a survey experiment augmented with administrative data to study preferences in buildings with and without individual metering and billing. We find overwhelming support for individual metering and billing, even with relatively high costs, and even among high consumers who stand to pay less with common billing.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调查实验和行政数据分析发现，即使面临较高成本，居民对独立计量和计费有强烈偏好，包括高能耗用户也愿意接受可能增加的费用。
AI.research_question: 居民是否愿意支付独立计量和计费的成本？
AI.motivation: 全球数百万家庭因缺乏独立计量表而需与邻居分摊公用事业账单，但独立计量已被证明能显著降低能耗，然而居民支付计量成本的意愿尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学和消费者偏好理论，研究居民在公用事业计量方式选择中的决策行为。
AI.method: 采用调查实验结合行政数据的方法，分析有和没有独立计量计费建筑中居民的偏好。
AI.findings: 研究发现居民对独立计量和计费有压倒性支持，即使成本较高，甚至包括高能耗用户也愿意接受可能增加的费用。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对居民公用事业计量偏好的理解，揭示了即使在可能增加费用的情况下，居民仍偏好独立计量的行为模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公用事业公司和政策制定者提供了重要参考，支持推广独立计量系统以促进能源节约。

title: The Future of Green and Blue Hydrogen in the Energy Transition and Net Zero Agenda
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Future of Green and Blue Hydrogen in the Energy Transition and Net Zero Agenda
detail.abstract:
As the global energy system undergoes a historic transformation toward decarbonisation, hydrogen has emerged as a cornerstone of future clean energy strategies. Increasingly recognised for its potential to decarbonise hard-to-abate sectors—such as heavy industry, long-distance transport, chemicals, and high-temperature manufacturing—hydrogen is being positioned by governments and industries as a key enabler of net-zero pathways. Among its various forms, green hydrogen, produced through electrolysis powered by renewable electricity, and blue hydrogen, generated from natural gas with carbon capture and storage (CCS), have gained the most traction in global policy and investment landscapes.

This paper critically evaluates the future of green and blue hydrogen in the context of the global energy transition, focusing on their respective contributions, limitations, and strategic roles in meeting mid-century net-zero targets. It explores key dimensions such as lifecycle greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, production scalability, cost trajectories, infrastructure compatibility, and the evolving regulatory frameworks across major economies.

Green hydrogen, while currently more expensive, is projected to become cost-competitive by 2030 in regions with abundant renewable resources. Its alignment with zero-emission goals and declining technology costs suggest it will form the long-term foundation of a decarbonised hydrogen economy. However, its growth is dependent on the rapid expansion of renewable energy capacity, electrolyser innovation, water availability, and supportive grid infrastructure. Conversely, blue hydrogen offers a more immediately scalable pathway by leveraging existing natural gas and CCS infrastructure. It is particularly attractive to fossil fuel-producing nations seeking to remain relevant in a carbon-constrained world. Yet, blue hydrogen’s future is constrained by methane leakage risks, incomplete carbon capture, and increasing scrutiny of its lifecycle emissions.

The paper further investigates the regional policy preferences—from the European Union’s strong green hydrogen mandate, to the United States’ neutral but incentive-rich Inflation Reduction Act (IRA), to hybrid strategies in the Middle East and Asia. It also examines the emergence of international hydrogen trade corridors, certification regimes, and the implications for global energy geopolitics.

Environmental and social trade-offs are addressed, including water use in electrolysis, CCS permanence concerns, and the need for a just and equitable hydrogen transition in developing economies. The analysis concludes that while green and blue hydrogen will coexist in the near term, the net-zero future will be predominantly green. Strategic deployment, targeted public policy, and emissions transparency will be essential to ensuring that hydrogen delivers meaningful climate benefits rather than serving as a low-ambition alternative.

Ultimately, this paper argues that hydrogen is not a silver bullet, but rather a critical piece of the decarbonisation puzzle that must be integrated into broader system-wide changes—including renewable electrification, energy efficiency, carbon pricing, and international cooperation. Decisions made in the next decade regarding hydrogen pathways will significantly influence whether the world can meet its climate commitments and ensure a sustainable, equitable energy future.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性评估了绿氢和蓝氢在全球能源转型中的未来，重点关注它们对实现2050年净零目标的贡献、局限性和战略作用。研究发现绿氢虽然目前成本较高，但预计到2030年将在可再生能源丰富地区具备成本竞争力，而蓝氢提供了更即时的规模化路径。分析认为，虽然短期内绿氢和蓝氢将共存，但净零未来将主要由绿氢主导。
AI.research_question: 绿氢和蓝氢在全球能源转型中的未来前景如何？它们各自在实现2050年净零目标中的战略作用和局限性是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着全球能源系统向脱碳转型，氢能已成为未来清洁能源战略的基石，特别是在难以减排的重工业、长途运输、化工和高温制造等领域。政府和产业界将氢能定位为实现净零路径的关键推动者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生命周期温室气体排放分析、技术成本曲线理论、能源转型路径模型和区域政策比较分析框架。
AI.method: 采用批判性评估方法，分析绿氢和蓝氢的关键维度，包括生命周期温室气体排放、生产可扩展性、成本轨迹、基础设施兼容性以及主要经济体的监管框架演变。
AI.findings: 1) 绿氢预计到2030年在可再生能源丰富地区具备成本竞争力，将成为脱碳氢经济的长期基础；2) 蓝氢通过利用现有天然气和CCS基础设施提供了更即时的规模化路径；3) 区域政策偏好存在显著差异；4) 短期内两种氢能形式将共存，但净零未来将主要由绿氢主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 构建了氢能转型的多维度评估框架；2) 提出了绿氢和蓝氢在能源转型中的战略互补性理论；3) 发展了区域政策偏好对氢能发展路径影响的分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供氢能发展路径的战略指导；2) 为投资者识别不同氢能技术的风险和机遇；3) 为产业界提供技术选择和基础设施投资决策依据；4) 强调排放透明度对确保氢能真正气候效益的重要性。

detail.abstract: In the context of the ICDS 2025 (2nd International Conference on Digital Sovereignty; Track 5 Geopolitics and Trust), this paper examines how data sovereignties have become a foundational challenge in the GenAI era. The monopolistic power of Big Tech platforms—so-called data-opolies—undermines democratic accountability, reshapes political agency, and destabilizes institutional trust by concentrating data flows within opaque algorithmic infrastructures and extractive AI economies. The paper reframes data sovereignty as an issue that manifests directly in technical domains, ranging from cybersecurity protocols and interoperable cloud architectures to federated learning systems and algorithmic accountability frameworks. Rather than treating sovereignty as an abstract principle, the analysis shows how it must be embedded in infrastructures, protocols, and governance models that balance social values with computational design. Yet, the computer science community has only marginally engaged with these debates, focusing on narrow technical fixes without addressing the structural asymmetries of data power. This paper issues a wake-up call: sovereignty is a systems-level design problem that demands interdisciplinary engagement. Against the extractive logic driving GenAI economics, the paper highlights emancipatory alternatives such as data cooperatives, public-interest digital commons, and accountability mechanisms rooted in civic participation. These models introduce new requirements for scalability, privacy, and incentive design that cannot be resolved without computer science contributions. Empirical illustrations from electoral infrastructures and urban data governance highlight vulnerabilities to asymmetry and opportunities for sovereignty-building. The paper advances a roadmap for policymakers, civil society, and technologists to embed sovereignty in trustworthy, resilient, and geopolitically relevant digital infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在GenAI时代数据主权如何成为基础性挑战，指出大型科技平台的数据垄断权力破坏民主问责、重塑政治代理并削弱制度信任。论文将数据主权重新定义为技术领域问题，强调需要将其嵌入基础设施、协议和治理模型中，并呼吁计算机科学界参与解决这一系统性设计问题。
AI.research_question: 在GenAI时代，数据主权如何成为基础性挑战，以及如何通过技术设计和治理模型来重新构建数据主权？
AI.motivation: 大型科技平台的数据垄断（数据寡头）正在破坏民主问责机制、重塑政治代理能力并削弱制度信任，这些平台通过不透明的算法基础设施和掠夺性AI经济集中数据流。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据主权理论、平台权力理论、算法治理理论、数字基础设施理论
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，结合选举基础设施和城市数据治理的实证案例说明
AI.findings: 数据主权直接体现在技术领域，包括网络安全协议、可互操作的云架构、联邦学习系统和算法问责框架；主权需要嵌入基础设施、协议和治理模型中，平衡社会价值与计算设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据主权重新定义为技术领域的具体问题而非抽象原则；提出主权作为系统性设计问题的概念框架；强调计算机科学在解决结构性数据权力不对称中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、公民社会和技术专家提供了将主权嵌入可信赖、有韧性且地缘政治相关的数字基础设施的路线图；提出了数据合作社、公共利益数字公域和基于公民参与的问责机制等解放性替代方案。

title: Debt Accumulation and Default in Low-Income Countries
affiliations: Loyola University Maryland - Department of Economics and Federal Housing Finance Agency

detail.title: Debt Accumulation and Default in Low-Income Countries
detail.abstract: This paper studies the accumulation of external public debt in low-income countries (LICs) after receiving debt relief from multilateral lenders. While LICs who received debt relief from the International Monetary Fund in the early 2000s generally lowered their external debt in the initial years of relief, many experienced fast resurgence in debt after borrowing limits were lifted in 2006. Using a difference-in-differences model, we find countries that benefited from the relaxation are more likely to experience a significant increase in their debt-to-GDP ratio. We quantitatively evaluate the effects of debt limit relaxation using a model of sovereign default with two types of debt: subsidized loans from multilateral institutions and non-concessional loans from the private market. The model is calibrated using data from Mozambique prior to its default in 2016, and we find that an impatient government is necessary to match the data on debt accumulation and investment. In the calibrated model, lifting limits on non-concessional borrowing results in a 17.1 percent loss in households' consumption-equivalent welfare. Furthermore, the welfare benefits of relaxing borrowing limits with a counter-factually patient government are relatively small.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了低收入国家在获得多边贷款机构债务减免后外部公共债务的积累情况。研究发现，2006年借款限制解除后，许多国家债务快速反弹，债务限额放松导致债务占GDP比率显著增加。基于莫桑比克数据的模型校准显示，非优惠借款限制解除会导致家庭消费等价福利损失17.1%。
AI.research_question: 低收入国家在获得债务减免后，外部公共债务积累的机制和影响因素是什么？特别是借款限制放松对债务积累和福利的影响。
AI.motivation: 低收入国家在获得IMF等机构债务减免后，虽然初期债务水平下降，但许多国家随后出现债务快速反弹，这种现象需要深入研究其背后的机制和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权违约模型，包含两种债务类型：多边机构的补贴贷款和私人市场的非优惠贷款。
AI.method: 双重差分模型和基于莫桑比克2016年违约前数据校准的定量模型分析。
AI.findings: 1. 借款限制放松的国家更可能出现债务占GDP比率显著增加；2. 非优惠借款限制解除导致家庭消费等价福利损失17.1%；3. 耐心政府的福利收益相对较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含两种债务类型的动态主权违约模型，揭示了政府时间偏好对债务积累决策的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于债务减免后借款限制管理的重要参考，强调了谨慎放松借款限制的必要性。

title: Meaningful Change Index: A P-Value Independent Metric for Assessing Robustness and Fragility in Continuous Outcomes
affiliations: University of Washington - School of Medicine

detail.title: Meaningful Change Index: A P-Value Independent Metric for Assessing Robustness and Fragility in Continuous Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract:
The assessment of statistical robustness in clinical trials with continuous outcomes has relied heavily on p-value dependent metrics that fail to address clinically meaningful differences. This study introduces the Meaningful Change Index - MeCI - a novel metric applied to continuous data that quantifies how distinguishable treatment groups are based on the crossover point of their sample distributions. It is independent of statistical significance testing. The Meaningful Change Index is defined as the minimum distance from group means to their distributional crossover point, normalized by the combined standard deviations. Unlike existing continuous fragility indices that depend on p-value thresholds, Meaningful Change Index focuses on a statistically meaningful numeric separation between populations. A worked example demonstrates temporal patterns of treatment effect evolution, revealing how group distinguishability changes over time despite robust binary outcomes when arbitrary thresholds are applied to the data. Meaningful Change Index provides clinically relevant fragility and robustness assessment for continuous data without dependence on statistical significance conventions, offering superior insights into treatment effect sustainability and group separation.

Version 2: Terminology updated from 'Meaningful Change Fragility (MCF)' to 'Meaningful Change Index (MeCI)' (MEK-see-eye) for clarity and collision avoidance. Core methodology unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了Meaningful Change Index (MeCI)这一新指标，用于评估连续数据的临床意义差异，不依赖p值，而是基于治疗组样本分布交叉点的可区分性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个不依赖统计显著性检验的指标来评估连续数据的临床意义差异和稳健性？
AI.motivation: 现有临床试验中连续结果的统计稳健性评估过度依赖p值相关指标，无法解决临床意义差异的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于样本分布交叉点的理论框架，通过计算组均值到分布交叉点的最小距离来量化治疗组的可区分性。
AI.method: 定义MeCI为组均值到分布交叉点的最小距离，用合并标准差进行标准化。
AI.findings: MeCI能够揭示治疗效应随时间演变的模式，即使在应用任意阈值时二元结果稳健的情况下，也能显示组间可区分性的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个不依赖统计显著性检验的新理论框架，用于评估连续数据的临床意义差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为连续数据提供了临床相关的脆弱性和稳健性评估，有助于深入了解治疗效应的可持续性和组间分离情况。

title: Global Metal Price Index and Geomagnetic Index Ap (1992 -2024)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Global Metal Price Index and Geomagnetic Index Ap (1992 -2024)
detail.abstract: The report uses a methodological approach based on W. S. Jevons and A. L. Chizhevsky. During the study period, the years of solar cycles were numbered according to the order established in solar astrophysics, grouped and compared with the arithmetic mean values of the indices of global prices for metals and the geomagnetic index Ap. The obtained models of the relationship between the index of global prices for metals and the geomagnetic index Ap have approximation reliability coefficients equal to 0.87 for 1-6 and 0.94 for 6-12 years of the average solar cycle. The study suggests a significant decrease in the index of global prices for metals in 2025 and 2026.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于杰文斯和奇热夫斯基的方法论，分析太阳活动周期与全球金属价格指数和地磁指数Ap之间的关系。研究发现两者存在强相关性，并预测2025-2026年全球金属价格指数将显著下降。
AI.research_question: 太阳活动周期与全球金属价格指数和地磁指数之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 探索天体活动对经济指标的可能影响，为金属价格预测提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于W.S. Jevons和A.L. Chizhevsky的理论框架，研究太阳活动对地球经济活动的影响。
AI.method: 将太阳周期年份按太阳天体物理学顺序编号，分组并与全球金属价格指数和地磁指数Ap的算术平均值进行比较分析。

detail.title: Sustainable Cultural Trends and Digital Influence: The Role of Instagram Influencers in Promoting Ethnic Wear among GEN-Z Women

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (11), 423-434, 2025
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: Today, in the fast and competitive business environment, fashion entrepreneurs must adapt to the ever-evolving fashion trends to withstand the market. Customer satisfaction and the tastes of younger generations, particularly Gen Z, greatly influence the fashion industry. With Gen Z's strong obligation to sustainability, there has been a significant shift toward fashion choices that align with ethical and cultural values. This study explores the connection of sustainable cultural trends and digital influence, examining how social media platforms, particularly Instagram, make it possible to promote and adopt ethnic fashion. The purpose of this research is to provide light on the interconnected nature of fashion, culture, and technology by investigating the impact of online influencers on consumers' fashion decisions. Specifically, the study focuses on how Instagram influencers promote ethnic wear among Gen Z women, highlighting their impact on the popularization of sustainable and culturally strengthening fashion trends. This study describes the demographic profile of the respondents. This research uses a simple random sampling technique alongside a descriptive research design. Factor analysis shows the most influential factors are social media influence, heritage, attitude of the younger generation, purchasing power, Instagram influencers, social responsibility, personal style and individuality, and price and affordability, and peer and friends adopting ethnic wear, while structural equation modeling (SEM) reveals the impact. The results highlight the importance of ethical and inclusive fashion practices and shed light on the influence of Instagram personalities on cultural sustainability as well as the fashion business.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨Instagram影响者如何通过社交媒体平台推广民族服饰，影响Z世代女性的时尚选择，促进可持续和文化强化的时尚趋势。研究发现社交媒体影响、文化传承、价格可承受性等因素对Z世代采纳民族服饰有显著影响。
AI.research_question: Instagram影响者如何影响Z世代女性采纳民族服饰，以及这种影响如何促进可持续和文化强化的时尚趋势？
AI.motivation: 在快速变化的商业环境中，时尚创业者需要适应不断演变的时尚趋势。Z世代对可持续性的强烈责任感推动了符合伦理和文化价值观的时尚选择，而社交媒体平台特别是Instagram在推广民族服饰方面发挥着重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体影响理论、可持续时尚理论、文化传承理论、消费者行为理论
AI.method: 采用简单随机抽样技术和描述性研究设计，结合因子分析和结构方程模型(SEM)分析数据
AI.findings: 因子分析显示最具影响力的因素包括：社交媒体影响、文化传承、年轻一代态度、购买力、Instagram影响者、社会责任、个人风格与个性、价格可承受性以及同伴采纳民族服饰。SEM分析揭示了这些因素之间的影响关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对社交媒体影响者如何促进文化可持续性的理解，扩展了可持续时尚与文化传承相结合的理论框架，为数字时代消费者行为研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为时尚创业者提供了关于如何通过社交媒体有效推广可持续民族服饰的实践指导，强调了伦理和包容性时尚实践的重要性，为时尚产业的可持续发展提供了策略建议。

detail.abstract:
This short article offers a practical guide for using AI tools to improve the judgment and efficiency of lawyers, mediators, and arbitrators.  It cites ABA Ethics Opinion 512, which describes lawyers’ ethical duty of technological competence under the ABA Model Rules.

The article encourages practitioners to begin by selecting AI tools appropriate to their tasks such as general-purpose platforms or specialized tools listed in the article.  It explains how to write effective prompts, use follow-up questions to refine outputs, and apply professional judgment when reviewing results.  It includes a list of suggested follow-up prompts.

Getting useful results from AI tools requires similar skills used in legal and dispute resolution work – skills that people can improve with practice.  The article includes numerous examples of AI prompts that can be used throughout the life of a case, from preparation to post-session reflection.

It cautions that AI tools can produce inaccurate, misleading, or fabricated content, and urges users to exercise human oversight and to independently verify results.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了律师、调解员和仲裁员使用AI工具提升判断力和效率的实用指南，强调在ABA道德规范下律师的技术能力义务，包括选择合适的AI工具、编写有效提示、使用跟进问题优化输出，并提醒需要人工监督和独立验证结果。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ABA道德规范中律师技术能力义务的理论框架，结合AI提示工程和人类监督理论。
AI.method: 提供实用指南方法，包括工具选择、提示编写、跟进问题使用和结果验证的具体步骤。
AI.findings: AI工具在法律工作中能够显著提升效率，但需要专业判断和人工监督来确保准确性；有效的提示工程和跟进问题是获得有用结果的关键。

affiliations: Goris State University, Zhytomyr Polytechnic State University, Zhytomyr Polytechnic State University, Shupyk National Healthcare University of Ukraine and Shupyk National Healthcare University of Ukraine

detail.title: The Genocide of Ukrainians in the Discourse of International Law as an Element of Russia's Political Self-Representation

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 18 (11), 375-382, 2025.
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: The issue of the consequences of the ideology of genocide as a determining factor in the development of Russian society for the dynamics of international legal processes has become particularly relevant against the backdrop of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine by the Russian Federation. This study is devoted to analyzing the ways in which Russia identifies itself in the international legal field in the context of the genocide of the Ukrainian people. The article examines the system of Russian measures aimed at the genocide of Ukrainians, which involve ideological pressure and censorship. The study reveals the existence of a consistent Russian policy toward the Ukrainian people that bears signs of genocidal intent. The study argues that the propaganda of genocide within the Russian Federation's political narrative is suggestive in nature, and the strategy itself is a tool for Russia's self-identification in the international environment, which influences the dynamics of the international legal system. The article analyzes approaches to the definition of genocide and the peculiarities of the representation of this concept in legal documents relating to the protection of fundamental human rights. The main evolutionary stages of the genocide of the Ukrainian people and the ways in which Russia identifies itself on this basis are identified. The article analyzes the variability of forms of practical expression of genocide aimed at the loss of national identity: mass torture and killings, forced deportations, and sexual violence. Particular attention is paid to the expression of Russian ideology of genocide against Ukrainians in the context of modern military operations: massive shelling and missile strikes, destruction of infrastructure, moral and informational influence, psychological means of destruction. The vectors of influence of the Russian Federation's methods of self-identification on the dynamics of the system of international legal relations are characterized. The functionality of the international judicial system in the process of bringing war criminals to justice is investigated. The destructive critical consequences of the Russian Federation's genocidal ideology for the security of global geopolitical development are substantiated.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析俄罗斯在乌克兰种族灭绝背景下如何在国际法领域进行自我定位，揭示俄罗斯对乌克兰人民的系统性种族灭绝政策及其对国际法律体系的影响。

AI.motivation: 在俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰的背景下，种族灭绝意识形态作为俄罗斯社会发展的决定性因素对国际法律进程的影响变得尤为重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 种族灭绝理论、国际法理论、身份认同理论、地缘政治安全理论
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究、法律文本分析、历史演变分析
AI.findings: 俄罗斯存在针对乌克兰人民的系统性种族灭绝政策，包括意识形态压力、审查制度、大规模酷刑和杀戮、强制驱逐、性暴力等多种形式；俄罗斯的种族灭绝宣传具有暗示性特征，是其在国际环境中自我定位的工具；这种自我定位方式对国际法律体系动态产生显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对种族灭绝意识形态在国际法律进程中作用的理解；拓展了国家自我定位与国际法律体系互动关系的理论框架；丰富了地缘政治安全背景下种族灭绝研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际司法系统追究战争罪行提供理论依据；为国际社会应对俄罗斯种族灭绝政策提供政策建议；为保护乌克兰民族认同和基本人权提供实践指导；为全球地缘政治安全风险评估提供参考。

title: DoW Effect in the Indian Stock Market: Evidence from NSE-200 and BSE-30 with Event-Study Analysis
affiliations: M. S. Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: DoW Effect in the Indian Stock Market: Evidence from NSE-200 and BSE-30 with Event-Study Analysis
detail.abstract: This study investigates the Day-of-the-Week effect in the Indian stock market using daily returns and trading volumes of the BSE-30 and NSE-200 indices over the period 2010-2025. The analysis addresses four objectives: (i) to test for the presence of weekday effects in stock returns, (ii) to examine weekday variations in trading volumes, (iii) to evaluate whether these anomalies weakened, strengthened, or disappeared following major structural and regulatory changes-including the 2014 government change, the 2016 demonetisation, and the 2020 COVID-19 pandemic, and (iv) to compare results between the BSE-30 and NSE-200 and provide recommendations for investors. Using pooled OLS regressions with weekday dummy variables (Friday as the benchmark), followed by panel Fixed Effects and Random Effects estimations, the results confirm the persistence of weekday anomalies in both indices. Returns analysis reveals a negative Monday effect across both indices and a positive Wednesday effect in the NSE-200. Trading volume analysis shows significantly lower activity on Mondays and higher activity mid-to end-week, with stronger and more diverse patterns in the NSE-200. Structural event analysis demonstrates that while the BSE-30 remained stable, anomalies in the NSE-200 were restructured, with Mondays turning negative and midweek returns turning strongly positive post-event. The findings suggest that the BSE-30 exhibits greater efficiency and resilience, making it more suitable for long-term investors, while the NSE-200 offers exploitable anomalies for active traders, though with higher risk. The persistence of anomalies, particularly in the broader market, underscores the need for regulatory measures to enhance liquidity and transparency. This study contributes to the literature by providing a long-horizon, dual-index analysis of weekday effects in India, linking anomalies to structural shifts and offering actionable insights for both investors and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2010-2025年印度股市的星期效应，发现BSE-30和NSE-200指数均存在持续性异常。BSE-30显示周一负效应，NSE-200显示周一负效应和周三正效应。交易量分析显示周一活动较低，周中至周末较高。结构事件分析表明BSE-30更稳定，NSE-200异常模式在事件后重组。
AI.research_question: 印度股市是否存在星期效应？这些异常如何随结构性和监管变化而演变？BSE-30和NSE-200指数在星期效应方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 检验印度股市的效率假说，分析星期效应的持续性，并评估主要结构事件（如政府更迭、废钞令、新冠疫情）对这些异常模式的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率假说、行为金融学、星期效应理论
AI.method: 使用2010-2025年BSE-30和NSE-200指数的日收益率和交易量数据，采用带星期虚拟变量的混合OLS回归（以周五为基准），随后进行面板固定效应和随机效应估计。
AI.findings: 两个指数均存在持续性星期异常：BSE-30和NSE-200均显示周一负效应，NSE-200还显示周三正效应。交易量周一较低，周中至周末较高。结构事件后，BSE-30保持稳定，而NSE-200异常模式重组。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了印度股市星期效应的长期双指数分析，将异常与结构变化联系起来，丰富了新兴市场效率研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供可操作建议：BSE-30更适合长期投资者，NSE-200为活跃交易者提供可开发异常但风险较高。为监管者提供增强流动性和透明度的政策建议。

detail.abstract: Why anxiety, depression, and aggression are not just personal struggles, but hidden cost centers of our economies-and how a systemic model can reverse the trend. Poland today lives with a crisis that no one officially calls a crisis. But numbers speak louder than rhetoric. Seventy-nine percent of children have faced violence. Forty-one percent of adolescents already experience symptoms of depression and anxiety. Every third has thought about suicide, and seven percent have attempted it. Behind each percentage is a life story. But together they add up to something larger: a structural threat to the economy, to innovation, to the very possibility of sustainable growth. Mental health is not a "soft issue." It is hard economics.

title: Tax Havens, Financial Crises, and Economic Resilience: Evidence from European Microstates
affiliations: and Beijing Normal University (BNU)

detail.title: Tax Havens, Financial Crises, and Economic Resilience: Evidence from European Microstates
detail.abstract: This article investigates the nexus between tax haven status, financial crises, and economic resilience in European microstates, focusing on Luxembourg, Liechtenstein, Monaco, and Andorra. Although microstates are often perceived as structurally vulnerable due to their small domestic markets, limited resources, and dependence on external shocks, several have shown remarkable resilience during episodes of global financial instability. Employing a mixed-methods approach, this study integrates quantitative analysis of macroeconomic indicators from 2000 to 2023 with qualitative assessment of institutional responses, policy reforms, and international negotiations. The findings demonstrate that tax haven characteristics-favorable tax regimes, financial secrecy, and niche specialization in financial services-created fiscal buffers that enhanced resilience during the 2008 global financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic. However, outcomes varied significantly across cases. Luxembourg's integration into European Union structures and diversified financial services enabled rapid recovery, while Liechtenstein preserved credibility through swift regulatory reforms. By contrast, Monaco and Andorra, more dependent on tourism and narrower financial systems, experienced deeper and more protracted downturns. These differences highlight that resilience is not solely a function of tax haven status but is shaped by institutional capacity, governance quality, and adaptability to shifting global norms. The study concludes that resilience in microstates is dynamic: tax haven models provide short-term advantages, but long-term stability requires diversification, regulatory compliance, and strategic reinvention. These insights contribute to broader debates on small states, global finance, and resilience theory, offering both academic and policy-oriented implications for sustaining economic stability in small, open economies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧洲微型国家中避税天堂地位、金融危机与经济韧性之间的关系。研究发现避税天堂特征（优惠税制、金融保密性、金融服务专业化）在2008年全球金融危机和COVID-19疫情期间提供了财政缓冲，增强了经济韧性。但韧性还取决于制度能力、治理质量和适应全球规范的能力。
AI.research_question: 避税天堂地位如何影响欧洲微型国家在金融危机中的经济韧性？
AI.motivation: 微型国家通常因国内市场小、资源有限和依赖外部冲击而被认为结构脆弱，但一些微型国家在全球金融不稳定时期表现出显著的韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济韧性理论、小型国家理论、全球金融治理理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：2000-2023年宏观经济指标的定量分析，结合制度响应、政策改革和国际谈判的定性评估
AI.findings: 避税天堂特征在危机期间提供了财政缓冲，增强了韧性。但结果因国家而异：卢森堡因欧盟一体化和多元化金融服务快速恢复；列支敦士登通过监管改革保持信誉；摩纳哥和安道尔因依赖旅游和金融系统较窄而衰退更深更久。
AI.theory_contributions: 对小型国家理论、韧性理论和全球金融研究的贡献，表明韧性是动态的，不仅取决于避税天堂地位，还受制度能力和适应性的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为小型开放经济体提供政策启示：避税天堂模式提供短期优势，但长期稳定需要多元化、监管合规和战略重塑。

title: Energy Security, Climate Security, and National Security
affiliations: Emory University School of Law

detail.title: Energy Security, Climate Security, and National Security
detail.abstract: This article examines the complex interrelation between energy security, climate security, and national security in the contemporary geopolitical context. It contends that although climate change poses a significant security challenge, energy security remains the essential foundation of national sovereignty and systemic stability. It underscores the risks of inflexible climate policies that may jeopardize the reliability, affordability, and autonomy of energy supplies, and calls for a pragmatic, evidence-based policy approach that balances climate mitigation with the imperatives of energy infrastructure integrity and strategic stability; a nuanced, integrated framework that prioritizes energy security as central to national security.

detail.abstract: Vacancies are collapsing across advanced economies even as GDP continues to rise. In the United Kingdom, postings have fallen by more than 40% since 2022, while in the United States new evidence shows disproportionate losses among younger workers in AI-exposed occupations. This paper argues that we may be witnessing the emergence of a 'recruitment recession': a structural decoupling of growth and labor demand at the point of entry. Drawing on macro vacancy data, firm-level hiring records, and payroll evidence, we highlight the risks of narrowing on-ramps to employment and propose a research agenda to investigate the causes, mechanisms, and implications of this phenomenon. This paper calls for systematic investigation to track and analyse these dynamics at scale.

title: Just-in-Time vs. Just-in-Case: Post-Pandemic Inventory Strategy Shifts

detail.title: Just-in-Time vs. Just-in-Case: Post-Pandemic Inventory Strategy Shifts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on secondary data and did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic revealed major weaknesses in global supply chains, particularly in firms that had long depended on lean, Just-in-Time (JIT) practices. Many organizations responded by introducing Just-in-Case (JIC) buffers to improve resilience, despite the higher costs involved. This paper examines how three multinational firms-Toyota in automotive, Inditex in fast fashion, and Amazon in e-commerce-revised their inventory strategies after 2020. Using a comparative case design and secondary data from annual reports and financial databases, inventory turnover trends were tracked between 2018 and 2024. Findings show that Toyota retained its JIT discipline but added targeted safety stocks and greater supplier flexibility; Inditex adopted a hybrid model that balances rapid product cycles with readiness; and Amazon expanded fulfillment capacity and upstream inventory in line with a stronger JIC posture. This study contributes to the resilience literature by clarifying how firms recalibrate the JIT-JIC mix under systemic risk. It advances theoretical understanding by showing that resilience strategies are not dichotomous but hybrid in practice, and it offers practical insights for managers designing inventory policies under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较丰田、Inditex和亚马逊三家跨国公司在疫情后库存策略的调整，发现企业并非简单地在JIT和JIC之间二选一，而是采用混合策略来平衡效率和韧性。
AI.research_question: 企业在系统性风险下如何重新调整JIT和JIC库存策略组合？
AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情暴露了依赖精益JIT实践的全球供应链的脆弱性，许多企业开始引入成本更高的JIC缓冲机制来提升韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精益生产(JIT)与缓冲库存(JIC)理论，供应链韧性理论
AI.method: 比较案例研究设计，使用年度报告和财务数据库的二手数据，追踪2018-2024年库存周转趋势
AI.findings: 丰田保留JIT但增加针对性安全库存和供应商灵活性；Inditex采用平衡快速产品周期与准备度的混合模式；亚马逊扩大履约能力和上游库存，强化JIC姿态
AI.theory_contributions: 推进理论理解，表明韧性策略在实践中不是二元对立的而是混合的
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者在不确定性下设计库存政策提供实践启示

detail.abstract: This chapter explores how organizational culture is created, embedded, reinforced, and transformed through deliberate and unconscious actions of leaders, structural choices, and everyday practices. It emphasizes the decisive role of founders and senior leaders in shaping culture by what they pay attention to, how they react to crises, and the mechanisms they use to allocate resources, rewards, and status. The chapter discusses Schein's framework of cultural embedding mechanisms and extends the analysis to recruitment, socialization, mission statements, ethics, technology, and the management of subcultures. The chapter concludes that culture is not static; it must be consciously managed and aligned with strategy to build resilient, innovative organizations capable of adapting to external pressures and opportunities.

detail.abstract: This paper explores the strategic integration of Six Sigma methodology with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) to drive sustainable operational excellence. Drawing from cross-industry experience-including aviation, automotive, consulting, and contact center operations-the author demonstrates how AI/ML can elevate Six Sigma from a reactive framework to a predictive engine. The paper maps AI/ML capabilities to each phase of DMAIC, offering a practical overlay that enhances speed, precision, and adaptability without compromising philosophical depth. Through real-world reflections at United Airlines, General Motors, Ford Motor Company, and contact center environments, the author illustrates how structured problem-solving and digital intelligence can work in tandem to reduce variation, improve quality, and empower the workforce. The paper emphasizes that Six Sigma is not reserved for Black Belts alone-it is a mindset accessible to anyone committed to intentional improvement. This work contributes to ongoing conversations around digital transformation, workforce equity, and legacy-building, offering a human-centered approach to operational innovation. It is intended for practitioners, strategists, and scholars seeking to bridge traditional quality frameworks with emerging technologies.

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Faced with accrued competition in the race to innovate and unstable geoeconomics forces, Europe competitiveness is stymied, particularly in frontier innovations. While offering significant potential returns, frontier innovations are risky, and, in the event of failure, costs are substantial, largely because of restructuring costs disproportionately high, disincentivizing European companies and resulting in a loss of competitive value. In this context, a crucial question arises: how to optimize investments in frontier innovations to turn it into a driver of competitiveness while mitigating risks? One answer is to approach innovation as a value-creation enabler, harnessing strategic opportunity gains and minimizing its costs-accounting for trade-off and hidden costs. We propose a value-driven framework to create strategic value and competitive advantage, supported by multidimensional, contextual and dynamic indicators which encompass the potential impacts of innovations within its ecosystem. As a strategic and performance management tool, a value-driven approach to innovation investment can generate shared benefits.

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the European Union as part of the Activity to Support Belarusian Entrepreneurship and Innovation Ecosystem. The authors thank the European Union for funding the 2023 research phase and all the entrepreneurs who shared their experiences despite personal and professional risks. Special recognition goes to the startup founders who continued building their companies while facing political persecution and sanctions challenges.

detail.abstract: This study examines the systematic displacement of entrepreneurial ecosystems under authoritarian pressure, using Belarus as a critical case study. Drawing on comprehensive longitudinal data from 220+ startups (2021) and in-depth interviews with 11 major startup founders (2023), we analyze how political instability and Western sanctions impact innovation communities. Our findings reveal a fundamental "entrepreneurial threat paradox" where authoritarian regimes simultaneously depend on and fear innovation communities. We document the largest recorded peacetime exodus of tech entrepreneurs, with 58% of Belarusian startup founders relocating internationally within one year. Paradoxically, relocated startups demonstrated enhanced performance, raising three times more capital abroad than previously. However, 64% of companies report negative impacts from sanctions, despite not being directly targeted. This research contributes to entrepreneurship literature by demonstrating how political risk shapes innovation ecosystems and provides evidence for policy frameworks supporting displaced entrepreneurial communities. Our findings have implications for understanding entrepreneurial resilience, the portability of innovation ecosystems, and the unintended consequences of economic sanctions on entrepreneurial ventures.

title: The Role of Patient Density in Improving the Effectiveness of Medicaid Managed Care
affiliations: University of Miami - Department of Management Science, Florida International University (FIU) and Florida International University (FIU) - College of Business

detail.title: The Role of Patient Density in Improving the Effectiveness of Medicaid Managed Care
detail.abstract: Medicaid Managed Care (MMC) has become the dominant delivery model for low-income populations in the United States, yet its effectiveness varies widely across hospitals. This study examines how the density of MMC patients within a hospital's caseload influences its response to capitation-based incentives. We introduce the concept of density-driven operational adaptation, which posits that a higher concentration of MMC patients increases the salience of payer incentives and motivates hospitals to realign workflows, discharge planning, and post-acute coordination. Using a natural experiment created by Florida's transition from fee-for-service to statewide MMC between 2013 and 2015, we find that hospitals with higher MMC density achieve shorter inpatient stays, higher post-acute care utilization, and lower 30-day readmissions and emergency department visits. These improvements are concentrated in postoperative care, where coordination and discharge timing are most critical, and are driven by current patient mix rather than accumulated experience. Our findings highlight the critical role of patient-type density in shaping the success of value-based payment reforms, with implications for policymakers seeking to strengthen MMC effectiveness and for hospital managers aiming to align operations with payer-driven incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了医疗补助管理式医疗（MMC）患者密度如何影响医院对按人头付费激励的响应。研究发现，MMC患者密度更高的医院能够实现更短的住院时间、更高的急性后护理利用率，以及更低的30天再入院率和急诊就诊率。

title: Case Study: Workplace Experience of Omkar at HP Store, Bhopal

detail.title: Case Study: Workplace Experience of Omkar at HP Store, Bhopal
detail.abstract: This case study explores the workplace experience of Omkar, a newly hired employee at an HP store in Bhopal, India. It highlights the challenges faced by Omkar during his on boarding process, marked by lack of training, unequal treatment, and managerial bias. Through his contrasting experience with another new employee, the case provides insight into workplace culture, favouritism, and the impact of exclusion on employee motivation. The study serves as an example for discussions on organizational behaviour, human resource practices, and employee engagement.

AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过对印度博帕尔HP商店新员工Omkar的职场经历进行深入分析
AI.findings: 新员工入职过程中存在明显的培训缺失、不平等对待和管理层偏袒现象；这些负面经历显著影响员工的工作动机和职场体验；职场排斥对员工心理状态产生消极影响
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了职场排斥和新员工社会化过程的理论研究；为组织行为学中的偏袒现象提供了实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业改进新员工入职培训体系提供参考；帮助管理者识别和避免职场偏袒行为；提升组织的人力资源管理实践效果
