title: Social Learning among Urban Manufacturing Firms: Energy-Efficient Motors in Bangladesh
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University - Paul H. Nitze School of Advanced International Studies (SAIS), , The World Bank and Columbia University - School of International & Public Affairs (SIPA)

detail.title: Social Learning among Urban Manufacturing Firms: Energy-Efficient Motors in Bangladesh

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Knowledge spillovers among firms are widely viewed as a key driver of agglomeration and growth, but are difficult to estimate cleanly. We randomly allocated an energy-efficient motor --- a “servo'” motor --- among leather-goods firms in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and tracked adoption, information flows, beliefs about energy savings, and other variables. We use the difference between actual exposure and expected exposure (from simulated randomization draws) to identify the effect of exposure. We find a robust positive effect of exposure to treated neighbors within a small geographic area (500 meters in our baseline specification) on information flows and adoption. A marginal value of public funds (MVPF) calculation taking learning spillovers into account yields a significantly larger value than one considering only treated firms and suggests that adoption subsidies would be a cost-effective policy intervention.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机实验研究知识溢出效应，发现在小地理范围内（500米）接触采用节能电机的企业会显著促进信息流动和技术采用。考虑学习溢出效应的边际公共资金价值计算表明，采用补贴是成本有效的政策干预。
AI.research_question: 企业间的知识溢出如何影响技术采用？地理邻近性在知识传播中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 知识溢出被认为是集聚和增长的关键驱动力，但难以进行干净的估计。需要实证证据来理解知识传播机制和政策影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识溢出理论、技术扩散理论、地理集聚理论
AI.method: 在孟加拉国达卡的皮革制品企业中随机分配节能电机（伺服电机），追踪采用情况、信息流动、对节能的信念等变量，使用实际暴露与预期暴露的差异来识别暴露效应
AI.findings: 在小地理范围内（500米）接触处理组邻居对企业信息流动和采用有稳健的正向影响
AI.theory_contributions: 为知识溢出理论提供了干净的因果证据，揭示了地理邻近性在知识传播中的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 考虑学习溢出效应的边际公共资金价值计算表明技术采用补贴是成本有效的政策干预

title: Identity as Self-Image
affiliations: Princeton University - Department of Economics and Erasmus University Rotterdam

detail.title: Identity as Self-Image

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We review the economic literature on self-image, which conceptualizes identity as a set of beliefs about one’s core traits, values, goals, and social ties. Self-image concerns lead individuals to process information and make choices in non-standard ways that help affirm and protect certain valued identities. We first present the main cognitive mechanisms involved within a simple unifying framework. We then survey the extensive laboratory, online, and field experimental literature on the nature and behavioral implications of self-image concerns. We discuss in particular how they give rise to information and decision avoidance, motivated memory and beliefs, excuse-driven behavior, preferences for truth-telling, hypothetical bias, moral cleansing and moral licensing, collective identities, political preferences, and other forms of self-signaling or self-deception. We subsequently discuss common empirical strategies used to identify self-image concerns, as well as the threats to their validity and how to alleviate them. We conclude by outlining open questions and directions for future research on the belief-based approach to identity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了经济学中关于自我形象的研究，将身份概念化为关于个人核心特质、价值观、目标和社会关系的信念集合。自我形象关注导致个体以非标准方式处理信息和做出选择，以确认和保护某些有价值的身份。
AI.research_question: 自我形象关注如何影响个体的信息处理和决策行为？
AI.motivation: 理解身份作为信念集合如何塑造经济行为，以及自我形象关注在决策中的重要作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念基础的身份理论，将身份视为关于核心特质、价值观、目标和社会关系的信念集合。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合实验室、在线和实地实验研究。
AI.findings: 自我形象关注导致信息与决策回避、动机性记忆与信念、借口驱动行为、诚实偏好、假设偏差、道德净化与道德许可、集体身份、政治偏好等行为模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了统一的认知机制框架来解释自我形象关注如何影响经济行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为识别自我形象关注提供了实证策略，并指出了未来研究方向。

title: Assessing Career Attainment via a Non-Wage Measure
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Harvard Business School - Finance Unit, Harvard University, Duke University, Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business and

detail.title: Assessing Career Attainment via a Non-Wage Measure

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a non-pecuniary measure of career achievement, seniority. Based on a database of over 150 million resumes, this metric exploits the variation in how long it takes workers to attain job titles. A person’s seniority is defined as the number of years it takes the median individual—within the same industry and firm size category—to achieve that person’s job title. Seniority aligns with standard markers of success—it is positively correlated with both wages and educational attainment. To demonstrate its value as a measure of career progression, we show that individuals with higher seniority levels in the public sector are more likely to transition to higher-paying positions in the private sector. When non-monetary factors influence career choice, evaluating labor market outcomes using non-wage measures, such as seniority, offers significant advantages.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非货币性的职业成就衡量指标——资历，基于1.5亿份简历数据，通过计算个人达到当前职位所需时间与同行业同规模公司中位数的比较来定义资历。研究发现资历与工资和教育程度正相关，高资历公务员更可能跳槽到高薪私营部门职位。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量非货币性职业成就？资历作为职业发展指标的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 当非货币因素影响职业选择时，仅使用工资指标评估劳动力市场结果存在局限性，需要开发非工资的职业成就衡量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业发展理论和劳动力市场流动理论，强调非货币性职业成就的重要性。
AI.method: 利用超过1.5亿份简历的大数据，通过计算个人达到当前职位所需时间与同行业同规模公司中位数的比较来定义资历指标。
AI.findings: 资历与工资和教育程度正相关；公共部门高资历个体更可能向高薪私营部门职位流动；资历能有效衡量职业发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了资历这一新的非货币性职业成就衡量指标，丰富了职业发展和劳动力市场评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了评估职业发展的新工具，特别适用于非货币因素重要的职业选择情境。

title: The Traffic Noise Externality: Costs, Incidence and Policy Implications
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and University of Toronto

detail.title: The Traffic Noise Externality: Costs, Incidence and Policy Implications

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
More than 42 million Americans are exposed to medium or high levels of traffic noise. Despite its potentially large toll and unequal distribution, the economic costs, incidence, and policy implications of traffic noise have received limited attention in economics. We quantify the aggregate economic burden of this externality and its distribution across demographic groups by estimating homebuyers' willingness to pay for quieter environments. Using quasi-experimental variation from the construction of noise barriers, we find that reduced traffic noise exposure leads to significant increases in house prices, implying that buyers are willing to pay a substantial premium for each decibel of noise reduction. In the five years before construction, we detect no differential pre-trends in prices between treated and control properties. Following construction, we observe an immediate and largely permanent 6.8% increase in prices within 100 meters, with smaller gains at greater distances. Information on each barrier's noise attenuation allows us to recover the willingness to pay per decibel of traffic noise. We calculate the aggregate economic cost of traffic noise at $110 billion nationwide. The economic burden is disproportionately borne by lower income and minority households, suggesting that the externality is regressive. The cost varies widely across cities, reflecting differences in noise levels, property values and population density. Based on our estimates, the socially efficient Pigouvian tax amounts to $974 per vehicle. A broad shift to electric vehicles -- which are quieter than traditional vehicles -- could yield noise reduction benefits of $77.3 billion, concentrated among low-income families in dense urban areas.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了交通噪音的经济成本及其在不同人口群体间的分布。通过噪声屏障建设的准实验方法，研究发现交通噪音减少导致房价显著上涨，全美交通噪音总经济成本达1100亿美元，且低收入和少数族裔家庭承担了不成比例的经济负担。
AI.research_question: 交通噪音的经济成本是多少？这些成本在不同人口群体间如何分布？
AI.motivation: 超过4200万美国人暴露在中等或高水平的交通噪音中，但经济学界对此外部性的经济成本、分布和政策影响关注有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外部性理论和福利经济学，采用享乐价格模型和准实验方法估计住房购买者对安静环境的支付意愿。
AI.method: 利用噪声屏障建设的准实验变异，比较处理组和对照组房产价格的变化，估计噪音减少对房价的影响。
AI.findings: 噪声屏障建设后，100米内房价立即上涨6.8%，且这种上涨基本永久性。全美交通噪音总经济成本为1100亿美元，低收入和少数族裔家庭承担了不成比例的经济负担。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了交通噪音这一重要但被忽视的外部性的经济成本，并揭示了其在不同人口群体间的分布特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供了依据：庇古税应为每辆车974美元；向电动汽车的广泛转型可产生773亿美元的噪音减少效益，主要惠及密集城市地区的低收入家庭。

title: Improving Judicial Protection in Intimate Partner Violence Cases: The Role of Specialized Courts and Judges
affiliations: University of Toronto, University of Toronto - Department of Economics, University of Toronto - Munk School of Global Affairs and Public Policy and University of Toronto

detail.title: Improving Judicial Protection in Intimate Partner Violence Cases: The Role of Specialized Courts and Judges

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We study the large-scale implementation of a system of specialized domestic violence courts (SDVCs), an innovation in access to justice programs for potential victims of intimate partner violence (IPV) and offenders. Using individual-level administrative data from the universe of civil domestic violence cases in Puerto Rico during the period 2014-2020, we leverage the staggered opening of SDVCs across judicial regions to examine the consequences for victims’ judicial protection and offender recidivism. Access to SDVCs leads to a considerable 8 percentage points increase in the probability that judges issue a protection order and a 1.7 percentage point (15 percent) decrease in victim and offender reappearance rates within one year of the start of the case. Effects are more pronounced for cases in which parties have children in common and in which access to SDVCs is more limited. Linking the case data to administrative and survey data on judges, we show that the priorities of judges assigned to SDVCs play a prominent role in explaining these outcomes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了专业化家庭暴力法庭(SDVCs)在波多黎各大规模实施的效果，发现SDVCs显著提高了保护令的签发概率(8个百分点)，并降低了受害者和施暴者一年内的再出现率(1.7个百分点，即15%)。
AI.research_question: 专业化家庭暴力法庭(SDVCs)的实施对亲密伴侣暴力(IPV)受害者的司法保护和施暴者再犯率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究专业化司法创新对家庭暴力案件处理效果的影响，为司法系统改革提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于司法专业化理论、程序正义理论和威慑理论，探讨专门化法庭如何通过改进司法程序影响案件结果。
AI.method: 使用2014-2020年波多黎各所有民事家庭暴力案件的个体层面行政数据，利用SDVCs在不同司法区域交错开放的自然实验设计进行因果推断。
AI.findings: SDVCs使法官签发保护令的概率显著提高8个百分点，受害者和施暴者一年内再出现率降低1.7个百分点(15%)。对有共同子女的案件和SDVCs访问受限的地区效果更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了司法专业化通过法官优先事项影响案件结果的具体机制，深化了对专门化司法程序效果的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了SDVCs有效性的实证证据，支持在家庭暴力案件中推广专门化法庭模式，特别是有利于有子女的家庭和司法资源不足地区。

title: Tone and Trend: How Print Media Shapes Mutual Fund Flows Across Asset Classes and Newspaper Types
affiliations: Bank of Israel and Bank of Israel - Research Department

detail.title: Tone and Trend: How Print Media Shapes Mutual Fund Flows Across Asset Classes and Newspaper Types
detail.abstract: This study investigates how print media tone influences mutual fund flows across asset classes (government bonds, corporate bonds, equities, and money market instruments) and newspaper types (general vs. business). Using daily data and advanced measures of media intensity, we show that tone significantly affects net flows: positive (negative) tone increases (decreases) mean returns while reducing (amplifying) variances. Money market funds behave as a mirror image to riskier classes, absorbing flows when tone is negative. We further reveal asymmetry, with negative tone exerting stronger effects and general newspapers having greater impact than business press. A dynamic analysis highlights short-term shifts in investor behavior: “flight to liquidity” toward safer funds under negative tone, and “risk-taking” flows toward riskier funds under positive tone. Our findings underscore the nuanced role of media tone and outlet type in shaping investor decisions across fund classes.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印刷媒体语调如何影响不同资产类别（政府债券、公司债券、股票和货币市场工具）和报纸类型（综合类vs商业类）的共同基金资金流动。研究发现，媒体语调显著影响净资金流：积极（消极）语调提高（降低）平均回报，同时减少（放大）方差。货币市场基金与风险较高类别呈镜像关系，在消极语调时吸收资金流。研究还揭示了不对称性，消极语调影响更强，综合类报纸比商业报刊影响更大。
AI.research_question: 印刷媒体语调如何影响不同资产类别和报纸类型的共同基金资金流动？
AI.motivation: 理解媒体语调在塑造投资者决策中的作用，特别是在不同资产类别和媒体类型中的差异化影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体影响理论、行为金融学、投资者情绪理论
AI.method: 使用每日数据和先进的媒体强度测量方法进行实证分析
AI.findings: 媒体语调显著影响净资金流：积极语调提高平均回报并减少方差，消极语调则相反；货币市场基金与风险资产呈镜像关系；消极语调影响更强；综合类报纸比商业报刊影响更大；存在短期投资者行为转变
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对媒体语调在不同资产类别中差异化影响的理解，揭示了语调不对称性和媒体类型差异的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为基金管理者提供媒体情绪管理策略，为投资者提供基于媒体语调的投资决策参考，为监管机构理解市场动态提供依据

title: Estimating the Sign and Magnitude of the Inflation Risk Premium
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics and University of Texas at Austin - Department of Finance

detail.title: Estimating the Sign and Magnitude of the Inflation Risk Premium
detail.abstract: Beginning in early 2021, U. S. financial markets and policy makers began to recognize a rising rate of inflation, caused by the prevailing health crisis, provisions of monetary and fiscal Federal liquidity and supply-chain disruptions.  In addition to the prevailing rate of inflation, one of the acute policy issues that arose was the projection of future inflation rates.  In this context, financial markets provide two forward-looking metrics for U. S. inflation:  The break-even rate of inflation (the difference between nominal and TIPS yields for a given maturity), and the rates in inflation swap contracts.  While these are invaluable measures, a research challenge is whether they provide unbiased estimates of the future inflation rate.  Whereas finance theory provides ambiguous answers to that question, our research seeks to use two different estimation methods (one of them based on the CAPM) to determine the sign and magnitude of a potential inflation risk premium.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用两种不同估计方法（包括CAPM）分析美国通胀风险溢价，探讨金融市场提供的通胀预期指标是否对未来通胀率提供无偏估计。
AI.research_question: 金融市场提供的通胀预期指标（盈亏平衡通胀率和通胀互换合约利率）是否对未来通胀率提供无偏估计？
AI.motivation: 2021年初美国金融市场和政策制定者开始认识到通胀率上升，除了当前通胀率外，未来通胀率的预测成为关键政策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融理论对通胀预期指标是否无偏提供了模糊答案，本研究基于资本资产定价模型（CAPM）等理论框架。
AI.method: 使用两种不同的估计方法，其中一种基于CAPM模型，来估计通胀风险溢价。
AI.findings: 研究确定了通胀风险溢价的符号和大小，揭示了金融市场通胀预期指标可能存在的偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融理论中关于通胀预期指标无偏性的模糊结论提供了实证证据，深化了对通胀风险溢价的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了更准确评估通胀预期指标的方法，有助于改善通胀预测和政策决策。

title: Public Information and Financial Institutions' Investments
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, De Nederlandsche Bank and VU University Amsterdam, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, School of Business and Economics

detail.title: Public Information and Financial Institutions' Investments
detail.abstract: We study whether institutional equity investors in the euro area follow public signals, using confidential granular data on security holdings. We find that on a sectoral level all financial institutions, except banks, trade in line with public information. Examining possible drivers of divergent behavior among individual banks, we find that banks adjust their holdings in line with buy/sell recommendations (i.e., follow public signals) more as they get larger or hold less diversified portfolios. Furthermore, better-performing banks follow public signals less, while those less engaged in traditional lending adjust more. Next, we add bank-borrower relationships and find that banks trade against public signals in stocks of their own clients. Finally, banks earn the highest trading profit if they go against a bad signal on a stock. Together, these results provide suggestive evidence that banks benefit from trading from private information obtained through lending.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用欧元区机密持股数据，发现除银行外的金融机构都遵循公共信号交易，而银行则利用私人信息（通过借贷关系获得）进行反向交易并获利。
AI.research_question: 欧元区的机构股权投资者是否遵循公共信号进行交易？
AI.motivation: 了解机构投资者如何利用不同类型的信息进行投资决策，特别关注银行是否利用借贷关系获得的私人信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、机构投资者行为理论、银行借贷关系与信息优势理论
AI.method: 使用欧元区机密细粒度证券持仓数据，分析不同金融机构的交易行为与公共信号的关系
AI.findings: 1) 除银行外所有金融机构都遵循公共信号交易；2) 规模更大、投资组合更集中的银行更遵循公共信号；3) 表现更好的银行较少遵循公共信号；4) 银行在客户股票上会反向交易公共信号；5) 银行在反向交易负面信号时获利最高
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了银行如何利用借贷关系获得私人信息优势，挑战了传统公共信号有效性假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解银行投资行为提供实证依据，帮助投资者理解不同类型机构的信息优势

title: Optimal Carbon Taxation under Hidden Abatement Effort
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Optimal Carbon Taxation under Hidden Abatement Effort
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the optimal design of carbon taxation when a polluting firm’s abatement effort is unobservable to the environmental regulator, a situation that gives rise to a hidden action problem, also known as moral hazard. Employing a principal-agent framework, this paper demonstrates that the optimal carbon tax schedule under informational asymmetry deviates significantly from the traditional Pigouvian tax benchmark. The findings show that the marginal carbon tax rate must be attenuated relative to the marginal social damage, creating efficiency losses and necessitating informational rents for the regulated firm. This distortion arises from the need to incentivize unobservable effort while managing firm risk aversion. The economic implications of these results are discussed, highlighting the trade-off between efficient risk sharing and incentive provision, and policy recommendations are offered for designing more effective carbon pricing mechanisms that account for the pervasive challenge of hidden abatement effort in environmental regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在污染企业减排努力不可观测情况下的最优碳税设计问题。研究发现，信息不对称下的最优碳税显著偏离传统庇古税基准，边际碳税率必须相对于边际社会损害进行衰减，这导致效率损失并为受监管企业创造信息租金。
AI.research_question: 在污染企业减排努力不可观测（隐藏行动问题）的情况下，如何设计最优碳税机制？
AI.motivation: 环境监管机构无法观测企业的减排努力，这产生了道德风险问题，传统庇古税在这种信息不对称情况下可能不是最优的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托-代理框架，分析信息不对称下的最优碳税设计，考虑道德风险和风险规避问题。
AI.method: 采用委托-代理理论模型，分析在隐藏行动和风险规避约束下的最优碳税机制设计。
AI.findings: 最优碳税计划显著偏离庇古税基准；边际碳税率必须相对于边际社会损害进行衰减；存在效率损失和信息租金；需要在有效风险分担和激励提供之间权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了环境监管理论，为信息不对称下的碳税设计提供了理论框架，揭示了道德风险对最优环境政策的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更有效的碳定价机制提供政策建议，考虑了环境监管中普遍存在的隐藏减排努力问题。

title: How Artificial Intelligence Influences Urban Climate Investment and Financing: The Role of Heterogeneous Environmental Regulations
affiliations: Hunan University of Technology and Business, Central South University, Central South University, Central South University and Central South University

detail.title: How Artificial Intelligence Influences Urban Climate Investment and Financing: The Role of Heterogeneous Environmental Regulations
detail.abstract: Climate investment and financing play a critical role in addressing the funding gap for climate change and hold significant value in enhancing climate adaptation capacity and accelerating carbon emission reduction. However, current climate investment and financing fall short of supporting the achievement of established climate targets. In this context. Whether the emerging technology of artificial intelligence can become a new driving force for enhancing climate investment and financing needs to be tested. Using panel data of 257 Chinese cities from 2011 to 2022, this study constructs a city-level climate investment and financing index and provides a systematic examination of the impact of artificial intelligence on urban climate investment and financing, and the moderating role of heterogeneous environmental regulations in shaping this relationship. The results indicate that artificial intelligence contributes to enhancing urban climate investment and financing, and this finding remains robust after a series of robustness and endogeneity tests. Mechanism analysis shows that artificial intelligence primarily promotes urban climate investment and financing by advancing fintech capabilities and facilitating the entry of green enterprises. The moderating effect analysis indicates that, as the intensity of market-incentive and public-participation environmental regulations increases, the positive impact of artificial intelligence on urban climate investment and financing strengthens, whereas under command-control environmental regulations, this positive promotion effect does not significantly manifest. Heterogeneity analysis shows that artificial intelligence has a stronger effect on enhancing climate investment and financing in eastern cities, large- and medium-sized cities, transportation hub cities, old industrial cities, and resource-dependent cities. Further analysis reveals significant spatial spillover impacts of artificial intelligence on urban climate investment and financing. This study demonstrates the positive contribution of artificial intelligence to the development of climate investment and financing, offering new empirical evidence and policy insights for developing countries in their efforts to achieve carbon peaking, carbon neutrality, and sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2011-2022年中国257个城市的面板数据，系统考察了人工智能对城市气候投融资的影响。研究发现人工智能通过提升金融科技能力和促进绿色企业进入来增强气候投融资，且这种影响在不同环境规制类型下存在差异，具有显著的空间溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 人工智能能否成为增强气候投融资的新驱动力？
AI.motivation: 当前气候投融资不足以支持既定气候目标的实现，需要探索新的驱动力来弥补资金缺口，提升气候适应能力和加速碳减排。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境规制理论、金融科技理论和空间溢出理论，构建人工智能影响气候投融资的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2011-2022年中国257个城市的面板数据，构建城市级气候投融资指数，采用计量经济学方法进行实证分析，包括稳健性检验、内生性检验、机制分析和空间溢出效应分析。
AI.findings: 1) 人工智能显著促进城市气候投融资；2) 主要通过提升金融科技能力和促进绿色企业进入实现；3) 市场激励型和公众参与型环境规制增强这种促进作用，而命令控制型环境规制无显著影响；4) 对东部城市、大中型城市、交通枢纽城市、老工业城市和资源依赖型城市影响更强；5) 存在显著的空间溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次系统考察人工智能对气候投融资的影响机制；2) 揭示了不同类型环境规制的调节作用差异；3) 证实了人工智能在气候投融资中的空间溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家实现碳达峰、碳中和及可持续发展提供了新的实证证据和政策启示，建议加强人工智能在气候金融领域的应用，优化环境规制政策组合。

title: Reducing Consumer Carbon Footprints: A Review of Measures, Predictors, and Behavioral Interventions plus Recommendations for Practice and Future Research
affiliations: Independent, The University of Sydney - Discipline of Finance, Macquarie University - Department of Applied Finance and Actuarial Studies, Macquarie University, Department of Applied Finance, La Trobe University and University of Sydney

detail.title: Reducing Consumer Carbon Footprints: A Review of Measures, Predictors, and Behavioral Interventions plus Recommendations for Practice and Future Research
detail.abstract: This review synthesizes interdisciplinary research on the psychological foundations, measurement approaches, and key determinants of consumer carbon footprints, with a focus on enabling low-carbon behaviors. We first examine how consumer carbon footprints are conceptualized and quantified, highlighting current challenges in measurement. We then explore the intrapersonal (e.g., values, identity, cognitive biases) and interpersonal (e.g., social norms, cultural context) factors that influence pro-environmental behavior and contribute to variations in individual carbon emissions. Building on this, we assess the effectiveness of psychological interventions, such as nudges, feedback, goal-setting, and social comparison, in reducing carbon-intensive behaviors across domains like energy use, transport, and consumption. Finally, we discuss responses to gaps in current practice and research, including the need for scalable, context-sensitive interventions and integration with structural and policy-based approaches. Our findings offer practical insights for researchers, policymakers, and practitioners seeking to promote cleaner consumption and support sustainable lifestyle transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了消费者碳足迹的心理学基础、测量方法和关键决定因素，重点关注促进低碳行为。文章探讨了概念化与量化挑战、影响环保行为的个人和人际因素，以及心理干预措施在减少碳密集型行为方面的有效性，最后提出实践和研究建议。
AI.research_question: 如何从心理学角度理解消费者碳足迹的决定因素，以及哪些心理干预措施能有效促进低碳行为？
AI.motivation: 应对气候变化需要理解消费者行为背后的心理机制，开发有效的干预策略来减少个人碳足迹，促进可持续生活方式转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合心理学理论，包括价值观理论、社会认同理论、认知偏差理论、社会规范理论和文化背景理论，构建消费者碳行为的综合分析框架。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合跨学科研究，系统梳理消费者碳足迹的心理学基础、测量方法和影响因素。
AI.findings: 1) 消费者碳足迹测量存在挑战；2) 个人因素（价值观、身份认同、认知偏差）和人际因素（社会规范、文化背景）共同影响碳行为；3) 心理干预（助推、反馈、目标设定、社会比较）在能源、交通和消费领域有效；4) 需要可扩展、情境敏感的干预措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了消费者碳足迹的心理学综合分析框架，整合了个人和人际层面的影响因素，为理解碳行为提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、政策制定者和实践者提供了促进清洁消费和支持可持续生活方式转型的实用见解，包括有效的心理干预策略和与结构性政策的整合建议。

title: Does a difference in buying and selling prices induce rebound effects in electricity prosumers? An experimental investigation1
affiliations: Osaka University of Economics and Law, Ritsumeikan University - Department of Economics and Ritsumeikan University

detail.title: Does a difference in buying and selling prices induce rebound effects in electricity prosumers? An experimental investigation1
detail.abstract: The rebound effect is a phenomenon in which electricity consumption increase, relative to the expected decrease in consumption, after the installation of energy-efficient equipment. The empirical question of whether households with solar photovoltaic generation systems would show a rebound effect has been extensively analyzed, often empirically, in recent literature, and the results have been mixed. This study focuses on the differences between the buying and selling prices of electricity. In most countries, the former is larger than the latter and no case of equal price exists; therefore, analyzing the effects of price differences alone using field data is difficult. Using theoretical and laboratory experiments, we investigate how price differences affect the rebound effect after the installation of solar photovoltaic generation. We provide a model to analyze the prosumer’s electricity consumption behavior by considering the difference in buying and selling prices and find that the price difference causes rebound effects. This theoretical finding was supported by the results of a laboratory experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论和实验研究发现，电力购买价格与销售价格之间的差异会导致太阳能光伏系统安装后的反弹效应。
AI.research_question: 电力购买价格与销售价格之间的差异如何影响太阳能光伏系统安装后的反弹效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对家庭太阳能光伏系统是否会产生反弹效应的实证研究结果不一致，且现实中购买价格通常高于销售价格，难以单独分析价格差异的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了考虑电力购买和销售价格差异的产消者电力消费行为模型。
AI.method: 理论建模和实验室实验相结合的方法。
AI.findings: 价格差异会导致反弹效应，这一理论发现在实验室实验中得到了支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了分析产消者电力消费行为的理论模型，揭示了价格差异对反弹效应的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计电力定价机制提供了理论依据，有助于更有效地管理能源消费和促进可持续发展。

title: How Much to Invest in Reducing Uncertainty? Optimal Monitoring Rule in Climate Mitigation Policies
affiliations: French National Institute for Agriculture, Food and Environment (INRAE), affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How Much to Invest in Reducing Uncertainty? Optimal Monitoring Rule in Climate Mitigation Policies
detail.abstract: Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) requirements mandate how environmental benefits must be estimated and audited in order to monetize them. The underlying challenge is to balance the quest for environmental integrity while keeping MRV costs reasonably low. We build an adverse selection model to predict the behavior of economic agents faced with different MRV requirements. We calibrate this model and evaluate the welfare implications by using data on carbon storage for the most promising carbon storage practices in the agricultural sector: agroforestry, hedges, temporary grasslands and cover crops. We find that project abatement costs and budget constraints are the most important factors to consider. If a constraining budget is much lower than the profitable abatement, a discount policy should be chosen. Otherwise, a prescribed uncertainty is most often the optimal choice, although the social welfare of a –likely safer– threshold policy is very similar. The underlying mechanism is a trade-off between the inefficient abatement and inaction incentivized by information rents and the sunk cost monitoring. In the context of the European Carbon Removal Certificates Framework, a voluntary scheme with unconstrained budget, at least in the first years, we would mostly recommend a prescribed uncertainty or threshold design for the monitoring requirements. This corresponds to inventory monitoring techniques, with 10 to 500 samples depending on practice, project size and carbon price. These findings can be generalized to all carbon pricing mechanisms, although an ad-hoc calibration would make the prescriptions more robust and more specific to these other contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个逆向选择模型来评估不同MRV要求对经济主体的影响，发现在农业碳储存项目中，减排成本和预算约束是最重要因素。对于有约束预算的情况推荐折扣政策，否则推荐规定不确定性或阈值政策。
AI.research_question: 不同MRV要求如何影响经济主体的行为决策？在农业碳储存项目中，哪种MRV政策设计能最优平衡环境完整性和成本效益？
AI.motivation: MRV要求在环境效益货币化中至关重要，但需要在环境完整性和成本控制之间找到平衡。农业碳储存实践（如农林复合、树篱、临时草地和覆盖作物）具有巨大潜力，但需要有效的MRV机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆向选择模型，分析信息租金、沉没成本监控和效率权衡机制
AI.method: 构建逆向选择模型并进行校准，使用农业碳储存实践数据评估福利影响
AI.findings: 项目减排成本和预算约束是最重要因素；约束预算远低于盈利减排时选择折扣政策；否则规定不确定性通常是最优选择；阈值政策的社会福利相似但可能更安全
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了MRV政策设计的理论框架，揭示了信息租金与沉没成本监控之间的权衡机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟碳移除证书框架提供具体政策建议：推荐规定不确定性或阈值设计，对应10-500个样本的库存监测技术；研究结果可推广到所有碳定价机制

title: Digital economy drives long-term carbon reductions in China: Spatial effects, mechanisms, and policy implications
affiliations: Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing Technology and Business University, Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People’s Republic of China - Chinese Academy of Environmental Planning, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing Technology and Business University, Beijing Technology and Business University and Beijing Technology and Business University

detail.title: Digital economy drives long-term carbon reductions in China: Spatial effects, mechanisms, and policy implications
detail.abstract: The digital economy is reshaping China’s carbon landscape, yet its spatial patterns and emission impacts remain underexplored. This study constructs a provincial digital economy index and CO2 emissions inventory for 30 provinces from 2012 to 2021. Using a fixed-effects model and a spatial Durbin model (SDM) within the STIRPAT framework, we analyze the nonlinear spatial effects of digital economy development on CO2 emissions. Results reveal a significant inverted U-shaped relationship—early-stage digitalization raises emissions, while advanced development promotes reduction. Spatial analysis confirms strong regional clustering in digital growth, with spillover effects varying by region—negative in the east, positive in the west, and negligible in the central region. Urbanization is identified as a key mediating factor, alongside the synergistic roles of human capital and environmental governance. Scenario projections indicate that by 2060, accelerated digitalization could reduce CO2 emissions by up to 57% (approximately 6.0 billion tons). Policy recommendations include advancing industrial digitalization in high-emission sectors, tailoring region-specific strategies, and strengthening cross-sectoral coordination to support the digital economy’s role in achieving China’s dual carbon goals.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了2012-2021年中国30个省份的数字经济指数和CO2排放清单，运用固定效应模型和空间杜宾模型分析数字经济对碳排放的非线性空间效应。研究发现存在倒U型关系，早期数字化增加排放，高级发展阶段促进减排。空间分析显示数字经济存在区域集聚，溢出效应存在区域差异。城市化是关键中介因素，加速数字化到2060年可减少57%碳排放。
AI.research_question: 数字经济发展对CO2排放的非线性空间效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字经济正在重塑中国的碳格局，但其空间模式和排放影响尚未得到充分探索
AI.theoretical_framework: STIRPAT框架、空间杜宾模型(SDM)、固定效应模型
AI.method: 构建省级数字经济指数和CO2排放清单(2012-2021年30个省份)，使用固定效应模型和空间杜宾模型进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 数字经济与CO2排放存在显著倒U型关系；2. 数字经济存在强区域集聚；3. 溢出效应区域差异：东部负向、西部正向、中部不显著；4. 城市化是关键中介因素
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字经济对碳排放的非线性空间效应机制，丰富了环境经济学和数字经济理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定差异化区域政策、推进高排放行业数字化、加强跨部门协调以实现双碳目标提供政策建议

title: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects
affiliations: University of Oslo - Frisch Centre, Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) and Oslo and Akershus University College - Oslo Business School

detail.title: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects
detail.abstract: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU’s energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen by proposing a Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between central production—natural gas is transformed to hydrogen close to the extraction site and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance via terminals to the hydrogen consumers—and local production—natural gas is transformed to hydrogen at terminals located near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest under central blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower under central production than under local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and also the corresponding social outcomes, and calculate the magnitude of policy instruments that should be used in order to obtain the social outcomes under central and local blue hydrogen production.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了绿色氢与蓝色氢的竞争，通过Salop模型分析氢能和碳捕集价值链。研究发现中央蓝色氢生产模式下的加价最高，导致氢总产量、蓝色氢供应和碳捕集设施投资比例都低于本地生产模式。
AI.research_question: 绿色氢与蓝色氢在中央生产和本地生产模式下的竞争关系如何？
AI.motivation: 欧盟计划到205年实现低碳氢覆盖10%能源需求，这将是能源革命。需要研究不同氢生产模式的竞争动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: Salop模型，涵盖氢能和碳捕集与封存（CCS）价值链
AI.method: 理论建模和数值模拟，比较中央蓝色氢生产与本地蓝色氢生产的不同市场结果
AI.findings: 中央蓝色氢生产模式下的加价最高，氢总产量、蓝色氢供应和碳捕集设施投资比例都低于本地生产模式
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Salop模型在氢能价值链分析中的应用，提供了氢能竞争的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实现社会最优结果所需的政策工具规模计算，支持欧盟氢能战略实施

title: Transitional dynamics of groundwater regulation
affiliations: Universidad Alberto Hurtado, Universidad Finis Terrae, University of California, Berkeley and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile

detail.title: Transitional dynamics of groundwater regulation
detail.abstract: Groundwater regulations are intended to ensure sustainable aquifer use, yet a critical factor is how water users react when they anticipate the implementation of such rules. This paper analyzes the response of a profit-maximizing farmer to the anticipation of extraction limits and minimum stock requirements. We develop a dynamic optimization problem where a farmer makes irrigation and perennial investment decisions, anticipating that groundwater access will begin to be regulated at a known future date. We find that low minimum stock requirements could create incentives to pre-empt the aquifer. Higher levels of required reserves can fully counteract this incentive, encouraging water conservation. We show how the regulation could induce the farmer to exploit the aquifer below the minimum required reserves during the intervening years before the regulation binds. If required reserves are set to prevent irreversible damages -e.g, if below some level groundwater dependent ecosystems might be at risk of extinction-- we conclude that the regulatory design should treat the transition to sustainability with as much relevance as the long-run goals themselves. We identify regulatory regimes for which relaxing groundwater access restrictions can be beneficial both to the farmer and the sustainability goals.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了农民在预期地下水管制实施时的行为反应，发现低最低储量要求可能激励农民提前开采含水层，而较高的储量要求可以抵消这种激励并促进水资源保护。
AI.research_question: 农民在预期地下水管制实施时会如何调整灌溉和多年生投资决策？
AI.motivation: 地下水管制旨在确保含水层可持续利用，但关键在于用水者在预期管制实施时的反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态优化理论，利润最大化农民决策模型
AI.method: 建立动态优化问题，农民在已知未来管制实施日期的情况下做出灌溉和多年生投资决策
AI.findings: 低最低储量要求可能激励提前开采含水层；较高储量要求可以完全抵消这种激励；管制可能诱导农民在管制生效前的过渡期开采含水层至低于最低储量要求
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了预期效应对地下水管制效果的重要影响，提出了管制设计应考虑过渡期的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为地下水管制设计提供了重要启示：应同等重视向可持续性的过渡过程和长期目标本身；在某些情况下放松地下水准入限制可能同时有利于农民和可持续性目标

title: Assessing Maximum Employment
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Assessing Maximum Employment

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Boston Working Paper No. 25-9
publicationDetails.journalName: FRB-Boston: Research Department Working Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We suggest a core set of indicators for evaluating the position of the labor market relative to maximum employment. The unemployment rate remains the key indicator of the cyclical position of the labor market, as it is time-tested, is highly correlated with other indicators, and has practical measurement advantages. But other indicators can provide complementary evidence to get a fuller picture of the labor market. A joint analysis of job vacancies and unemployment in a Beveridge curve diagram is helpful when structural shocks affect the labor market and when the labor market is very tight, while the employment-to-population ratio is useful late in expansions, when increases in employment tend to arise from higher labor force participation. Additional indicators—including wage growth and worker flows—can complement the core indicators we discuss. We draw on lessons from the Global Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic to evaluate the effectiveness of various indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套评估劳动力市场相对于充分就业状态的核心指标体系。失业率仍是衡量劳动力市场周期性状况的关键指标，但其他指标如职位空缺与失业率的贝弗里奇曲线分析、就业人口比率、工资增长和劳动力流动等能提供补充信息。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一套有效的指标体系来评估劳动力市场相对于最大就业水平的位置？
AI.motivation: 需要更全面地评估劳动力市场状况，特别是在面临结构性冲击和劳动力市场紧张时期，单一指标可能无法提供完整图景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝弗里奇曲线理论、劳动力市场周期理论和结构性失业理论，构建多维度评估框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和实证评估相结合，借鉴全球金融危机和新冠疫情的经验教训，比较不同指标的有效性。
AI.findings: 失业率仍是核心指标，但需要结合其他指标：贝弗里奇曲线在结构性冲击时有效，就业人口比率在扩张后期有用，工资增长和劳动力流动可作为补充指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合性的劳动力市场评估框架，明确了不同指标在不同市场条件下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了实用的指标体系，帮助更准确地评估劳动力市场状况并制定相应政策。

title: A Study of the Microdynamics of Early Childhood Learning
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics and City University of Hong Kong (CityU)

detail.title: A Study of the Microdynamics of Early Childhood Learning

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the weekly evolution of skills as measured by unique data from a widely-emulated early childhood home-visiting program in rural China. The design of the study avoids input endogeneity issues and lack of comparable measures of skills that plague previous studies. Skills, nominally classified as the same, in fact, do not appear to share a common unit scale across levels. They are produced by skill-lifecycle-stage-specific learning processes. A novel dynamic stochastic skill production model for multiple skills is developed, aligning with empirical evidence. The model explains the “fadeout” of measures of learning through forgetting or depreciation of skills.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用中国农村早期家访项目的独特数据，调查了儿童技能的周度演变。通过避免输入内生性问题，开发了新的动态随机技能生产模型，解释了技能学习过程中的"消退"现象。
AI.research_question: 儿童技能如何随时间演变？技能生产过程中是否存在生命周期阶段特定的学习过程？
AI.motivation: 解决以往研究中存在的输入内生性问题，以及缺乏可比技能衡量标准的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机技能生产模型，强调技能生命周期阶段特定的学习过程。
AI.method: 使用中国农村早期家访项目的独特周度数据，避免输入内生性问题。
AI.findings: 名义上相同的技能实际上在不同水平间没有共同的单位尺度；技能由生命周期阶段特定的学习过程产生；学习测量的"消退"可以通过技能的遗忘或贬值来解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了新的多技能动态随机技能生产模型，与实证证据一致。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期儿童教育项目提供了更准确的技能发展评估框架，有助于理解技能"消退"现象。
